translations.source: ሳንዳርባን በዓለም ትልቁ የማንግሮቭ ዳርቻ ይዘት ናቸው፣ ከባንግላዴሽ እና ህንድ ሰፈሮች ዳርቻው 80 ኪ.ሜ (50 ማይል) ይዘረጋል።
translations.reference: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
translations.hypothesis: Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest in the world, located on the delta of the Ganges, Brahmaputra, and Meghna rivers in Bangladesh and India. It stretches for approximately 80 kilometers (50 miles) along the coast.

translations.source: ሰንዳርባን የዩኔስኮ የዓለም ቅርስ መሆኗ ታውጇል። በሕንድ ግዛት ውስጥ ያለው የደን ክፍል ሰንዳርባንስ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ ተብሎ ይጠራል።
translations.reference: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
translations.hypothesis: Sunderbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The forested area within the Indian state is known as the Sunderbans National Park.

translations.source: ነገር ግን ደኖቹ የማንግሮቭ ረግረጋማዎች ብቻ አይደሉም - በአንድ ወቅት የጋንጌቲክ ሜዳን የሸፈኑትን አስፈሪ ጫካዎች የመጨረሻ ቀሪዎችን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
translations.hypothesis: However, the dunes are not just composed of mangrove sediments; they also include the remnants of the dense forests that once covered the Gangetic plains.

translations.source: ሰንዳርባን 3,850 ኪ.ሜ² ፣ ስፋት ይይዛል፣ ከዚህም አንድ-ሦስተኛው በውሃ/በረግረግማ ስፍራዎች የተሸፈነ ነው።
translations.reference: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
translations.hypothesis: Sendarban covers an area of 3,850 square kilometers, and one-third of this area is covered by water bodies and wetlands.

translations.source: ከ1966 ጀምሮ ሰንዳርባኖች የዱር እንስሳት መኖሪያ ሆነዋል፣ እናም በአሁኑ ጊዜ በአካባቢው 400 ሮያል ቤንጋል ነብሮች እና 30,000 አካባቢ ነጠብጣብ ያለባቸው ሚዳቋ እንደሚገኙ ይገመታል።
translations.reference: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1966, the Sundarbans have been a habitat for wild animals, and it is currently estimated that the area is home to approximately 400 Bengal tiger individuals and around 30,000 spotted deer.

translations.source: አውቶቡሶች ቀኑን ሙሉ ከየአውራጃው የአውቶቡስ መናኸሪያ (ከወንዙ ማዶ) ይነሳሉ ፣ ምንም እንኳን አብዛኛዎቹ በተለይም ወደ ምስራቅ እና ጃካር/ቡምታን የሚጓዙት ከ 06:30 እስከ 07:30 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ ይነሳሉ።
translations.reference: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
translations.hypothesis: Buses depart throughout the day from the regional bus station (across the river), although the majority, especially those traveling east or to Jakar/Bumthang, depart between 6:30 AM and 7:30 AM.

translations.source: የወረዳ ውስጥ አውቶቡሶች በብዛት ሙሉ ስለሆኑ፣ ትንሽ ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ ትኬት መግዛት ይመከራል።
translations.reference: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the high demand and frequent overcrowding of buses within the district, it is recommended to purchase your tickets a few days in advance.

translations.source: አብዛኞቹ ወረዳዎች ምቹ እና ጠንካራ በሆኑ ትናንሽ የጃፓን ኮስተር አውቶቡሶች ይገለገላሉ።
translations.reference: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
translations.hypothesis: Most districts use comfortable and reliable small Japanese coastal buses.

translations.source: እንደ ፓሮ (Nu 150) እና ፓኑካ (Nu 200) ያሉ የጋራ ታክሲዎች በአቅራቢያ ወዳሉ ቦታዎች ለመጓዝ ፈጣን እና ምቹ መንገዶች ናቸው።
translations.reference: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.hypothesis: Shared taxis, such as those known as "Paro" (Nu 150) and "Panuka" (Nu 200), are a quick and convenient way to travel to nearby locations.

translations.source: የኦያፖክ ወንዝ ድልድይ በገመድ የተሰራ ድልድይ ነው። የብራዚልን የኦኢፖክ ከተማና በፈረንሳይ ጊኒ የሚገኘውን ሴንት-ጎርጅስ ዲ ለኦያበክ ለማገናኘት ሙሉ የኦያፖክ ወንዝን ይሸፈናል።
translations.reference: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
translations.hypothesis: The Oiapoque River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the entire Oiapoque River, connecting the Brazilian city of Oiapoque with the town of Saint-Georges-de-l'Oiapoque in French Guiana.

translations.source: ሁለቱ ማማዎች ከፍታቸው 83 ሜትር ነው፣ ቁመቱ 378 ሜትር ሲሆን 3.50 ሜትር ስፋት ያለው ሁለት መንገድ አለው።
translations.reference: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
translations.hypothesis: The two bridges have a height of 83 meters, a length of 378 meters, and consist of two roadways, each with a width of 3.50 meters.

translations.source: ከድልድዩ ስር ያለው ቀጥታ ከፍታ 15 ሜትር ነው። ግንባታ የተጠናቀቀው በኦገስት 2011 ነው፣ እስከ ማርች 2017 ለህዝብ ክፍት አልሆነም።
translations.reference: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
translations.hypothesis: The direct height from the base of the structure is 15 meters. The construction was completed in August 2011, but it was not opened to the public until March 2017.

translations.source: የብራዚል የጉምሩክ ፍተሻ ይጠናቀቃል ተብሎ በሚጠበቅበት፣በሴፕቴምበር 2017 ድልድዩ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲሠራ ታቅዷል።
translations.reference: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
translations.hypothesis: The Brazilian customs inspection facility, which was expected to be completed in September 2017, is now fully operational.

translations.source: ጓራኒ አሁን ምስራቅ ፓራጓይ የሆነው ውስጥ ከእጅ ወደ አፍ ግብርናንም እየሰሩ እንደ ክፊል-ዘላን አዳኞች የሚኖሩ፣ በጣም አስፈላጊ የሃገሩ ተወላጅ ቡድን ነበሩ።
translations.reference: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
translations.hypothesis: The Guarani, who now inhabit the region that is now eastern Paraguay, were an important indigenous group who practiced agriculture and lived as semi-nomadic people.

translations.source: የቻኮ ክልል እንደ ጓይኩሩ እና ፓያጉዋ ያሉ ሌሎች የአገሬው ተወላጅ ጎሳዎች በአደን ፣ በመሰብሰብ እና በማጥመድ የተረፉ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
translations.hypothesis: The Chaco region was home to other indigenous groups, such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived through hunting, gathering, and fishing.

translations.source: በ 16 ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን ፓራጓይ፣ ቀደም ሲል “የሕንዶች ግዙፍ ግዛት”፣ ተብሎ ይጠራ የነበረው የተወለደው የእስፔን ድል አድራጊዎች ከአገር-በቀል ቡድኖች ጋርተጋጥመው በመጣው ውጤት ነው።
translations.reference: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
translations.hypothesis: In the 16th century, Paraguay, formerly known as the "Vast Empire of the Indians," was the result of the victories of Spanish conquistadors who encountered and clashed with indigenous groups within the region.

translations.source: ስፔናውያን ለሦስት መቶ ዓመታት የቆየውን የቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The Spanish began a period of colonization that lasted for three hundred years.

translations.source: በ 1537 አሱንሱዮን ከተመሠረተበት ጊዜ አንስቶ፣ ፓራጓይ ብዙ አገር በቀል ባህሪያትን እና ማንነቶችን ለማቆየት ችላለች።
translations.reference: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
translations.hypothesis: Since its founding in 1537, Paraguay has managed to preserve many of its traditional customs and cultural identities.

translations.source: አርጀንቲና በአለም ላይ በጣም ምርጥ ከሆኑት የፖሎ ቡድኖች እና ተጫዋቾች አንዱን በመያዝ በደምብ ትታወቃለች።
translations.reference: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
translations.hypothesis: Argentina is renowned worldwide for having one of the best national football teams and players.

translations.source: የዓመቱ ታላቅ ውድድር በዲሴምበር ላስ ካኒታስ ውስጥ ፖሎ መስኮቹ ጋር ያካሄዳል።
translations.reference: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
translations.hypothesis: The annual major competition takes place in December in Las Canitas, featuring polo matches.

translations.source: እዚህ በሌሎች የአመቱ ጊዜያትም ትንንሽ ውድድሮች እና ጨዋታዎችም ሊታዩ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
translations.hypothesis: Small competitions and games may also be held at other times of the year.

translations.source: ለውድድሮች ዜናዎችና ለፖሎ ጨዋታዎች የት ትኬቶችን እንደሚገዙ አሶሴሽን አርጀንቲና ዲ ፖሎን ይመልከቱ።
translations.reference: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.hypothesis: For news updates and information on where to purchase tickets for polo matches, please visit the Asociación Argentina de Polo website.

translations.source: ኦፊሲያላዊ የፎክላንድ መገበያያ ዋጋው ከአንድ የብሪታኒያ ፓውንድ (ጂቢፒ) ጋር እኩል የተቀመተው የፎክላንድ ፓውንድ (ኤፍኬፒ) ነው።
translations.reference: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
translations.hypothesis: The official exchange rate of the Falkland Islands currency, the Falkland Pound (FKP), is set at par with one British Pound (GBP).

translations.source: ገንዘብ ከ FIC ዌስት መደብር ባሻገር በስታንሌይ በሚገኙት ደሴቶች ብቸኛው ባንክ ሊለወጥ ይችላል።
translations.reference: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
translations.hypothesis: You can exchange currency at the bank located in Stanley, which is the only bank that accepts currency from the FIC West store.

translations.source: የብሪታንያ ፓውንድ በአጠቃላይ በደሴቶቹ ላይ በማንኛውም ቦታ ተቀባይነት አላቸው እንዲሁም የስታንሊ የክሬዲት ካርዶች እና የአሜሪካ ዶላርም እንዲሁ ብዙውን ጊዜ ተቀባይነት አላቸው።
translations.reference: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
translations.hypothesis: The British pound is generally accepted throughout the islands, and Stanley credit cards and US dollars are also often accepted.

translations.source: የብሪታኒያና ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መገበያያ ሊወሰድ ቢችልም በውጨኞቹ ደሴቶች የዱቤ ካርዶች ተቀባይነት ላይኖራቸው ይችላል፤ ተቀባይነት ያለው የክፍያ ዘዴ ምን እንደሆነ ከባልተቤቶቹ ጋር ቀድመው ያረጋግጡ።
translations.reference: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
translations.hypothesis: While British and US credit cards may be accepted, they might not be accepted on the outer islands. It's best to confirm with the establishments beforehand which payment methods they accept.

translations.source: የፋልክላንድን ገንዘብ ከዴሴቱ ውጪ መለወጥ የማይቻል ነገር ነው፤ ስለዚህ ደሴቱን ከመልቀቅዎ በፊት ገንዘብዎን ይለውጡ።
translations.reference: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
translations.hypothesis: It is impossible to exchange Falkland Islands currency outside of the islands; therefore, exchange your money before leaving the island.

translations.source: ከሞንቴቪዲዮ ከምድር ወገብ በስተደቡብ ስለሆነ፣ በሰሜናዊ ንፍቀ ክበብ ክረምት ሲሆን በዚያው በጋ እና በተቃራኒው ደግሞ ክረምት ነው።
translations.reference: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
translations.hypothesis: Since Montevideo is located in the Southern Hemisphere, it experiences seasons opposite to those in the Northern Hemisphere. Therefore, when it is summer in the Northern Hemisphere, it is winter in Montevideo, and vice versa.

translations.source: ሞንቴቪዲዮ ከፊል ሞቃታማ ክፍል ውስጥ ይገኛል፤ በበጋ ወራት፣ +30°C የሙቀት መጠኖች የተለመዱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
translations.hypothesis: Montevideo is located in a subtropical region, and temperatures during the summer months often reach above 30°C.

translations.source: ክረምቱ በአወዛጋቢ ሁኔታ ቀዝቃዛ ሊሆን ይችላል፥ የሙቀት መጠኑ ውሃ በረዶ ከሚሆንበት ደረጃ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ነው ዝቅ የሚለው፣ ነገር ግን ነፋሱ እና እርጥበቱ ተቀላቅሎ የሙቀት መለኪያው ከሚለው ይልቅ ቀዝቃዛ እንደሆነ ያስመስለዋል።
translations.reference: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
translations.hypothesis: Summer can sometimes feel surprisingly cool, with temperatures occasionally dropping to near freezing. However, the combination of wind and humidity often makes it feel colder than the thermometer reading suggests.

translations.source: የተለዩ “ዝናባማ” እና “ደረቅ” ወቅቶች የሉም፤ የዝናብ መጠን አመቱን ሙሉ ከሞላ ጎደል ተመሳሳይ ሆኖ ይቆያል።
translations.reference: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
translations.hypothesis: There are no distinct "rainy" and "dry" seasons; the amount of rainfall remains relatively consistent throughout the year.

translations.source: አብዛኞቹ ፓርክ ውስጥ ያሉት እንስሦች ሰዎችን ማየት የለመዱ ቢሆኑም፣ የዱር ህይወት ያው የዱር ነውና ሊመገቡም ወይም ሊረበሹም አይገባም።
translations.reference: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
translations.hypothesis: While most of the animals in the park are accustomed to seeing people, it's important to remember that they are still wild animals and should not be fed or disturbed.

translations.source: በፓርክ ባለስልጣናቱ መሰረት ከድቦችና ተኩላዎች ቢያንስ 100 ያርዶች/ሜትሮች እና ከሁሉም ሌሎች እንስሳት 25 ያርዶች/ሜትሮች ርቀው ይቆዩ።
translations.reference: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
translations.hypothesis: According to park authorities, visitors must maintain a distance of at least 100 yards (meters) from bears and wolves, and 25 yards (meters) from all other animals.

translations.source: የፈለገ ገራም ቢመስሉም፣ ጎሽ፣ ከርከሮ፣ አጋዘን፣ ድቦች እና ሁሉም ትልቅ እንሰሳዎች ሊያጠቁ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
translations.hypothesis: While they may appear harmless, mushrooms, fungi, and even certain plants can be poisonous to dogs, cats, and other large animals.

translations.source: ተገቢውን እርቀት ባለመጠበቃቸው በየአመቱ ደርዘኖች ጎብኚዎች ተጎድተዋል። እነዚህ እንስሳት ትልቅ፣ የዱር፣ እና አደገኛ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ቦታ ይስጧቸው።
translations.reference: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
translations.hypothesis: Every year, visitors are harmed by wild animals due to failing to maintain a safe distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so it's important to give them space.

translations.source: በተጨማሪ፣ ሽታዎች ድቦችን እና ሌሎች የዱር እንስሳትን እንደሚስቡ ይወቁ፤ ስለዝህ ሽታ ያላቸውን ምግቦች ከመያዝም ከመስራትም ይቆጠቡ እናም ማረፊያዎን ያጽዱ።
translations.reference: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, be aware that scents can attract bears and other wildlife; therefore, avoid leaving food out, properly store your food, and keep your campsite clean.

translations.source: አፒያ የሳሞአ ዋና ከተማ ናት። ከተማዋ በኡፖሉ ደሴት ላይ ናት እና ለትንሽ ከ40,000 ያነሰ የህዝብ ቁጥር አላት።
translations.reference: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
translations.hypothesis: Apia is the capital city of Samoa. The city is located on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.

translations.source: አፒአ በ1850ዎቹ ተመሥርቶ ከ1959 ጀምሮ የሳሞኣ ዋና ከተማ ሆኗል።
translations.reference: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the capital of Samoa since 1959.

translations.source: በ 1889 ከጀርመን፣ ከአሜሪካ እና ከብሪታንያ ሰባት መርከቦች ወደብ ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ ሳይሆኑ በመቅረታቸው ወደቡ ብዙም የማይታወቀው የባህር ኅይል ፍጥጫ መድረክ ሆኖ ነበር።
translations.reference: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
translations.hypothesis: In 1889, the port served as a bustling hub for naval power, as seven ships from Germany, the United States, and Great Britain were preparing to depart, despite the fact that the port itself was relatively unknown.

translations.source: ከአንድ የእንግሊዝ የጦር መርከብ ውጪ፣ ሁሉም መርከቦች ሰምጠው ነበር። 200 የሚሆኑ የአሜሪካውያን እና የጀርመናዊ ህይወቶች አለፉ።
translations.reference: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
translations.hypothesis: Besides one British warship, all the other ships were sunk. Approximately 200 American and German lives were lost.

translations.source: በማኡ እንቅስቃሴ በተዘጋጀው የነጻነት ትግል ወቅት ከተማው ውስጥ የነበረ ሰላማዊ ስብስብ የታላቁን አለቃ ቱፗ ታማሴሴ ሊያሎፊ IIIን መገደል አስከትሏል።
translations.reference: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.hypothesis: During the struggle for freedom organized by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering within the city resulted in the assassination of the prominent leader, Chief Túpac Amaru II.

translations.source: በኦክላንድ ሁለት ወደቦች ምክኒያት ብዙ የባህር ዳርቻዎች አሉ። በጣም የታወቁት በሶስት ቦታዎች ይገኛሉ።
translations.reference: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
translations.hypothesis: Oakland has many beaches due to its two harbors. The most popular ones are located in three different areas.

translations.source: ሰሜናዊ ዳርቻ ያላቸው ባህሮች (በሰሜን ወደብ ዲስትሪክት) በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ላይ ሲሆኑ በሰሜን በኩል ከሎንግ ቤይ እስከ በደቡብ በኩል ደቨንፖርት ድረስ ይለጠጣሉ።
translations.reference: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
translations.hypothesis: The northern coastal regions (specifically, the North Port District) are located on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.

translations.source: ሁሉም ማለት ይችላል ለመዋኘት አመቺ የሆኑ አሸዋማ የባህር ዳርቻዎች ናቸው፣ ብዙዎቹ በፖሁቱካዋ ዛፎች የሚቀርብ መጠለያ አላችው።
translations.reference: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
translations.hypothesis: These are all ideal locations for swimming, with sandy beaches and many offering shade from pohutukawa trees.

translations.source: ታማኪ ድራይቭ የባህር ዳር መዝናኛዎች በሴንትራል ኦክላንድ ውስጥ በሚሽን ቤይ እና ኤስቲ ሄኤርስ ውድ የከተማ ዳርቻዎች ውስጥ በዌይቲማታ ወደብ ላይ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
translations.hypothesis: Tamaki Drive, a popular waterfront destination in central Auckland, is located along Mission Bay and St Heliers, offering stunning views of the city skyline and the Waitemata Harbour.

translations.source: እነዚህ አንዳንዴ የሚጨናነቁ የተለያዩ ዓይነት የባሕር ዳርቻውን የከበቡ ሱቆች የሚገኙባቸው የቤተሰብ የባሕር ዳርቻዎች ናቸው። መዋኘት የሚያስተማምን ነው።
translations.reference: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
translations.hypothesis: These are sometimes crowded, but charming, family-friendly beach areas with a variety of shops lining the shore. They are a great place to learn how to swim.

translations.source: ዋናው የሀገር ውስጥ ቢራ 'ቁጥር አንድ' ነው፣ ውስብስብ ቢራ ሳይሆን፣ አስደሳች እና አርኪ ነው። ሌላው የሀገር ውስጥ ቢራ "ማንታ" ይባላል።
translations.reference: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
translations.hypothesis: The most popular domestic beer is called "Number One"; it's not a complex beer, but rather refreshing and easy-drinking. Another domestic beer is called "Manta."

translations.source: የሚወሰዱ ብዙ የፈረንሳይ ወይኖች አሉ፣ ግን የኒው ዚላንድ እና አውስትራሊያ ወይኖች የተሻለ ሊጓዙ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
translations.hypothesis: There are many French wines available, but New Zealand and Australian wines might be a better option for travel.

translations.source: የአካባቢው የቧንቧ ውሃ ለመጠጣት ፍጹም ደህና ነው፣ ነገር ግን ከፈሩ የታሸገ ውሃ ለማግኘት ቀላል ነው።
translations.reference: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
translations.hypothesis: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but it's also easy to find bottled water if you prefer.

translations.source: ለአውትራሊያኖች የ’ፍላት ነጭ’ ቡና ሀሳብ በጣም የተለየ ነው። አጭር ጥቁር ‘ኤስፕሬሶ’ ነው፣ ካፕቺኖ በክሬም ተቆልሎ ይመጣል(አረፋ አይደለም)፣ እና ሻይ ደግሞ ያለ ወተት ነው የሚቀርበው።
translations.reference: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
translations.hypothesis: For Australians, the concept of a "flat white" coffee is quite specific. It's a short, strong espresso with a thin layer of steamed milk (not foamed), and tea is typically served without milk.

translations.source: ሙቅ ቸኮሌቱ የቤልጂየምን መስፈርቶች ያሟላ ነው። የፍራፍሬ ጭማቂዎች ውድ ቢሆኑም ግን በጣም ጥሩ ናቸው።
translations.reference: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
translations.hypothesis: The hot chocolate meets Belgian standards. Although the fruit juices are expensive, they are very good.

translations.source: ዓመቱን በሙሉ ወደ ባህር ውስጥ ጉዞዎች ይደረጋሉ፣ በባህር ውስጥ በተነሱት በእነዚህ ምክንያቶች የተነሳ የሚከሰቱ ጉዳቶች እምብዛም አይደሉም።
translations.reference: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
translations.hypothesis: Throughout the year, numerous trips are made to the sea, and unfortunately, accidents occur frequently due to the various hazards present in the marine environment.

translations.source: አሁንም ከባለስልጣናቱ ምክር ይውሰዱ፣ ሁሉንም ምልክቶች ይታዘዙ፣ እና ለደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያዎች የቅርብ ትኩረት ይስጡ።
translations.reference: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
translations.hypothesis: Always heed the advice of authorities, pay attention to all signs, and give close attention to safety warnings.

translations.source: የሣጥን ዝልግልግ ዓሣ (Box jellyfish) ከ1770 በስተሰሜን ከኦክቶበር እስከ አፕሪል በባህር ዳር መዝናኛዎች አጠገብና የወንዝ ማእበለገቦች አጠገብ ይከሰታል። ከነዚህ ጊዜያት ውጭ አልፎ አልፎ ሊገኙ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
translations.hypothesis: The box jellyfish is commonly found near coastal areas and river mouths from October to April, north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside of these months as well.

translations.source: ሻርኮች አሉ፣ ቢሆንም ሰው የሚያጠቁት አልፎ አልፎ ነው። አብዛኛዎቹ ሻርኮች ሰው ይፈራሉ እና ዋኝተው ይሸሻሉ።
translations.reference: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
translations.hypothesis: Sharks do exist, but they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are afraid of humans and will swim away if they encounter one.

translations.source: የጨዋማ ውሃ አዞዎች በውቅያኖሱ ውስጥ በደንም አይኖሩም፣ ዋናው መኖሪያቸው በሮክሃምፕተን በሰሜን ክፍል ያለው የኢስታውሪስ ወንዝ ነው።
translations.reference: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
translations.hypothesis: Dark water turtles are not found in the ocean; their primary habitat is the Estuary River, located in the northern part of Rockhampton.

translations.source: ቀድመው መመዝገብ፣ ከደረሱ በኋላ የሚያርፉበት ቦታ እንዳለ ስለሚያውቁ፣ ለተጓዦች የአእምሮ ሰላም ይሰጣቸዋል።
translations.reference: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
translations.hypothesis: Pre-registration provides peace of mind for travelers, as they know they have a confirmed place to stay upon arrival.

translations.source: እንደካምፕ ግቢዎች ላሉ ለሌሎች ማረፊያ አይነቶች በጉዞ ወኪል መመዝገብ የሚችሉ ሆነው ሊያገኙት ቢችሉም ብዙ ጊዜ የጉዞ ወኪሎች ከልዩ ሆቴሎች ጋር ስምምነቶች ይኖራቸዋል።
translations.reference: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
translations.hypothesis: While travelers might be able to find alternative accommodation options through travel agents, similar to what's available on campus, travel agents often have agreements with specific hotels.

translations.source: የጉዞ ወኪሎች አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ቁርስ፣ ከ/ወደ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያው የመጓጓዣ ዝግጅቶችን የሚያጠቃልሉ ጥቅሎችን ወይም የተዋሃዱ የበረራ እና ሆቴል ጥቅሎችን ያቀርባሉ።
translations.reference: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
translations.hypothesis: Travel agents often offer packages that include breakfast, transportation to and from the airport, or combined flight and hotel deals.

translations.source: እንዲሁም ስለአቅርቦቱ ለማሰብ ወይም ለመድረሻዎ ሌሎች ሰነዶችን (ለምሳሌ፥ ቪዛ) ለማግኘት ጊዜ ካስፈለግዎ እነርሱ ቦታውን ልይዙልዎት ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
translations.hypothesis: Also, if you need time to consider the offer or to obtain other documents (such as a visa) required for your destination, they can hold the position for you.

translations.source: ቢሆንም ማንኛውም ማሻሻያዎች ወይም ጥያቄዎች በቀጥታ በሆቴሉ ሳይሆን በጉዞ ወኪሉ ሊካሄዱ ይገባል።
translations.reference: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
translations.hypothesis: However, any modifications or requests should be made directly through the travel agent, and not directly to the hotel.

translations.source: ለአንዳንድ በአላት፣ በጣም ብዙዎቹ የሙዚቃ በአል ተሳታፊዎች በቦታው ላይ ለማረፍ ይወስናሉ፣ እና ብዙ ተሳታፊዎች ይህን የተሞክሮው ጠቃሚ ክፍል እንደሆነ ያስባሉ።
translations.reference: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.hypothesis: For some festivals, a significant number of music festival attendees choose to camp on-site, and many participants find this to be a valuable and enjoyable part of the experience.

translations.source: ለድርጊቱ ቅርብ መሆን ከፈለጉ ለሙዚቃ የቀረበ ስፍራ ለማግኘት ቀድመው መድረስ ይኖርቦታል።.
translations.reference: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.hypothesis: If you want to be close to the action, you should arrive early to secure a spot near the stage for the music performance.

translations.source: ዋናዎቹ መድረኮች ላይ ያለው ሙዚቃ ቢያልቅም ምሽቱ እስኪገፋ ድረስ ሙዚቃ የሚያጫውቱ የበአሉ ክፍሎች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ ያስታውሱ።
translations.reference: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
translations.hypothesis: Even though the music might stop on the main stages, remember that there may be other areas of the festival where music is still playing throughout the evening.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ፌስቲቫሎች ትንንሽ ልጆች ላሏቸው ቤተሰቦች የተለየ የካምፕ ማድረጊያ አካባቢ አላቸው።
translations.reference: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
translations.hypothesis: Some festivals have designated camping areas specifically for families with young children.

translations.source: በክረምት ወቅት ሰሜናዊውን ባልቲክን የሚያቋርጡ ከሆነ፤ በበረዶ ውስጥ መጓዝ በጣም ለተጎዱት በጣም አሰቃቂ ድምጽ ስለሚያስከትል የክፍል አቀማመጡን ያረጋግጡ፡፡
translations.reference: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
translations.hypothesis: If you are traveling across the Baltic Sea during the winter, ensure the placement of the equipment is secure, as walking on ice can be extremely dangerous and produce unsettling sounds for those affected.

translations.source: የሴይንት ፒተርስበርግ የመርከብ ጉዞዎች የከተማ ውስጥ ጊዜን ያጠቃልላሉ። የመርከብ ተጓዦች ከቪዛ ጥያቄዎች (ውሎቹን ይፈትሹ) ነፃ ተደርገዋል።
translations.reference: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.hypothesis: Saint Petersburg river cruises offer a way to experience the city. River cruise passengers are exempt from visa requirements (please check the specific regulations).

translations.source: ካሲኖዎች በተለምዶ እንግዶች የሚያጠፉትን ጊዜና ገንዘብ ለመጨመር ብዙ ጥረቶችን ያደርጋሉ። መስኮቶችና ሰአታት ብዙውን ጊዜ አይገኙም እና መውጫዎች ለማግኘት ሊያስቸግሩ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.hypothesis: Casinos typically employ various strategies to maximize the amount of time and money that guests spend within them. Windows and clocks are often absent, and exits can be difficult to find.

translations.source: እነሱ ባብዛኛው እንግዶችን በጥሩ ስሜት እንዲቆዩና በመግቢያው ላይ እንዲቆዩ ልዩ ምግብ፣ መጠጥ እና መዝናኛ አቅርቦቶች አላቸው።
translations.reference: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.hypothesis: They generally offer guests a welcoming experience and a pleasant stay, providing special food, drinks, and entertainment options, particularly in the reception area.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ቦታዎች የአልኮል መጠጦችን በነፃ ያቀርባሉ። ነገር ግን፣ መስከር ዳኝነትን ያሰናክላል፣ እና ሁሉም ጥሩ ቁማርተኞች አለመስከር ያለውን ጥቅም ያውቁታል።
translations.reference: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.hypothesis: Some establishments offer alcoholic beverages for free. However, alcohol impairs judgment, and all good players are aware of the advantage of staying sober.

translations.source: በከፍተኛ ኬክሮሶች ወይም በተራራ ማለፊያዎች ላይ የሚነዳ ማንም ሰው የበረዶ፣ በረዶ ወይም የሚያረጉ ልከ ሙቀቶች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ ሊያስብ ይገባል።
translations.reference: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone driving on high-elevation roads or mountain passes should be aware that they may encounter snow, ice, or extremely cold temperatures.

translations.source: በረዶዋማ እና በረዶ በሚዘንብባቸው መንገዶች፣ ሰበቃ ትንሽ ነው በባዶ አስፓልት ላይ እንደሚነዱት ሊነዱ አይችሉም።
translations.reference: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.hypothesis: On roads covered with ice or snow, a car with low ground clearance may not be able to drive as effectively as it would on a bare asphalt surface.

translations.source: ከፍተኛ ቅዝቃዜ ባለው በረዶ ጊዜ እንዳይንቀሳቀሱ ሊያደርጎት የሚችል በረዶ በጣም በአጭር ጊዜ ሊወርድ ይችላል።
translations.reference: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.hypothesis: During periods of extreme cold, a sudden and heavy snowfall can quickly accumulate, making it difficult or even impossible to move.

translations.source: ዕይታ በሚወድቅ ወይም በሚነፍስ በረዶ ወይም በውሃ መጤዝ ወይም በመኪና መስታወቶች ላይ በሚኖር በረዶ ሊከለከል ይችላል።
translations.reference: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.hypothesis: Visibility can be reduced by falling or blowing snow, heavy rain, or fog, or by snow accumulating on vehicle windshields.

translations.source: በሌላ በኩል በብዙ ሃገራት በረዷማና በረዷማ ሁኔታዎች የተለመዱ ናቸው፣ እና ትራፊክ ባብዛኛው አመቱን ሙሉ ሳይቋረጥ ይቀጥላል።
translations.reference: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.hypothesis: On the other hand, in many countries, rainy and dry seasons are common, and traffic generally continues uninterrupted throughout the year.

translations.source: ሳፋሪዎች፤ ምናልባትም በአፍሪካ ቱሪዝምን በከፍተኛ ደረጃ የሚስቡ እና ለብዙ ጎብኝዎች የሚያደምቁ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.hypothesis: Safaris are arguably one of the most popular and captivating aspects of tourism in Africa, attracting a large number of visitors.

translations.source: ሳፋሪ የሚባለው ቃል በተለመዶ የሚያምረውን የአፍሪካ የዱር ሕይወት በተለይም በሳቫና ላይ ለማየት በመሬት መጓዝን ያመለክታል።
translations.reference: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.hypothesis: The word "safari" refers to a journey, typically on land, undertaken to observe and appreciate the wildlife of Africa, particularly in the savanna regions.

translations.source: እንደ ዝሆኖች እና ቀጭኔዎች ያሉ አንዳንድ እንስሳት ወደ መኪናዎች የመቅረብ ዝንባሌ አላቸው ስለዚህ መደበኛ መሣሪያዎች ጥሩ እይታን ያስገኛሉ።
translations.reference: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.hypothesis: Some animals, such as rodents and insects, are attracted to cars, so standard equipment provides good visibility.

translations.source: አንበሶች፣ አቦ ሸማኔዎች እና ነብሮች አንዳንድ ጊዜ አይናፋር ናቸው እና በአጉሉ መነጽር የተሻለ ያዩአቸዋል።
translations.reference: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.hypothesis: Cats, owls, and certain other animals sometimes have pupils that are vertically oriented, and they see better with a magnifying glass.

translations.source: የእግር ጉዞ (“የቁጥቋጦ እርምጃ”፣ “የተራራ መውጣት ጉዞ” ወይም “በእግረኝነት” መሄድ ተብሎ ሚጠራው) ለጥቂት ሰአታት ወይም ብዙ ቀናት ተራራ መውጣትን ይጠቃልላል።
translations.reference: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.hypothesis: Hiking, also known as "trail walking," "mountain climbing," or simply "walking," typically involves traversing mountainous terrain for a few hours or several days.

translations.source: ፓራሊምፒክ ከኦገስት 24 ቀን እስከ ሴፕቴምበር 5 2021 ድረስ ይካሄዳል፡፡ አንዳንድ ዝግጅቶች በመላው ጃፓን ውስጥ በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ይካሄዳሉ።
translations.reference: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.hypothesis: The Paralympic Games will be held from August 24th to September 5th, 2021. Some events will take place in other locations throughout Japan.

translations.source: ጨዋታዎቹን በ1964 ስላስተናገደች ቶክዮ ብቸኛዋ ሁለት የክረምት ኦሎምፒኮችን ያስተናገደችህ ብችሀኛዋ የኤስያ ከተማ ትሆናለች።
translations.reference: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo, which hosted the Games in 1964, will become the first Asian city to host two Winter Olympics.

translations.source: ማራዘሚያው ከመነገሩ ቀድመው የ2020 በረራዎትን እና ማረፊያዎትን አስመዝግበው ከሆነ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.hypothesis: If the extension was applied before the user registered their 2020 flights and parking, they may encounter difficulties.

translations.source: የመሰረዝ መምሪያዎች ይለያያሉ፣ ግን እስከ ማርች መጨረሻ ባለው አብዛኞቹ ኮሮናቫይረስን መሰረት ያደረጉ የመሰረዝ መምሪያዎች ኦሎምፒኮቹ እስከተቀጠሩበት እስከ ጁላይ 2020 አይቆዩም።
translations.reference: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.hypothesis: While the specific guidelines vary, most coronavirus-related restrictions in place as of the end of March will not remain in effect until July 2020, the date originally scheduled for the Olympics.

translations.source: አይነተኛ ትኬቶች ¥7,000 አካባቢ የሚያስከፍሉ ሆኖ ሳለ አብዛኞቹ የሁነት ትኬቶች በ¥2,500 እና ¥130,000 መካከል እንደሚያስከፍሉ ይጠበቃል።
translations.reference: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: While regular tickets cost around ¥7,000, most reserved tickets are expected to be priced between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000.

translations.source: እርጥብ ልብሶችን መተኮስ እንዲደርቁ ይረዳቸዋል። ብዙ ሆቴሎች በክፍሉ ውስጥ ባይኖር እንኳን ለብድር የተዘጋጁ መተኮሻ እና የመተኮሻ ሰሌዳዎች አሉዋቸው።
translations.reference: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.hypothesis: Ironing helps to remove wrinkles from damp clothes. Many hotels have irons and ironing boards available for guests to use, even if they are not located in the room.

translations.source: ካውያ ከሌለ ወይም የተተኮሰ ካልሲ የማያስደስትዎት ከሆነ፣ ከተገኘ፣ የጸጉር ማድረቂያ መጠቀም ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.hypothesis: If you don't have a hairdryer or if the heat from a hairdryer isn't effective, you can try using a hair straightener if one is available.

translations.source: ጨርቁ በጣም እንዳይሞቅ ይጠንቀቁ (መጨማደድን ወይም በአንዳንድ ከባድ ሁኔታዎች መቃጠልን ሊያስከትል ይችላል)።
translations.reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.hypothesis: Be careful that the iron doesn't get too hot (as it could cause scorching or, in some cases, burning).

translations.source: ውሃን ለማጣራት የተለያዩ መንገዶች አሉ፣ አንዳንዶቹ ለተለዩ አስጊ ነገሮች ፍቱን ናቸው።
translations.reference: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.hypothesis: There are various methods for water purification, and some are more effective for dealing with specific contaminants.

translations.source: በአንዳንድ አካባቢዎች ውሃን ለአንድ ደቂቃ ማፍላት በቂ ነው፣ በሌሎች በርካታ ደቂቃዎች ያስፈልጋሉ።
translations.reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.hypothesis: In some areas, boiling water for just one minute is sufficient, while in other areas, it may require several minutes.

translations.source: ማጣሪያዎች በብቃት ይለያያሉ፣ እና ካሳሰብዎት ከዚያ ከተከበረ ኩባንያ ውሃዎትን በታሸገ ጠርሙስ ስለመግዛት ሊያስቡ ይገባል።
translations.reference: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.hypothesis: Filters vary in their effectiveness, and if you are concerned, you may want to consider purchasing bottled water from a reputable company.

translations.source: ተጓዦች የትውልድ አካባቢዎቻቸው ውስጥ የማያውቋቸው የእንሰሳ ተባዮች ሊያጋጥሟቸው ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.hypothesis: Travelers may encounter unfamiliar animal species within their native environments.

translations.source: ተባዮች ምግብ ሊያበላሹ፣ መቆጣትን ሊያስከትሉ፣ ወይም በባሰ ሁኔታ የአለርጂ አፀግብሮት ሊያስከትሉ፣ መርዝ ሊያስፋፉ፣ ወይም ልክፈቶችን ሊያስተላልፉ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.hypothesis: Certain foods can trigger anger, cause allergic reactions, exacerbate existing conditions, or even transmit infections.

translations.source: ተላላፊ በሽታዎች ራሳቸው ወይም በኃይል ሰውን ሊጎዱ ወይም ሊገድሉ የሚችሉ አደገኛ እንሰሳት፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ እንደ ተባይ አይቆጠሩም።
translations.reference: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.hypothesis: Infectious diseases, which can harm or even kill humans directly or indirectly, are often not considered animals in the traditional sense.

translations.source: በተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች ግዴታ የሆነ ግብር ነጻ የሆኑ የተወሰኑ ዕቃዎችን የመግዛት ዕድል ዲዩቲ ፍሪ ሽመታ ነው።
translations.reference: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.hypothesis: In certain areas, duty-free shops offer the opportunity to purchase a selection of goods that are exempt from taxes.

translations.source: ከባድ ግብር ወዳላቸው ሃገራት የሚጓዙ ተጓዦች አንዳንድ ጊዜ በተለይ እንደ የአልኮል መጠጦች እና ትምባሆ ካሉ ምርቶች ብዙ መጠን ያለው ገንዘብ ሊቆጥቡ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.hypothesis: Travelers visiting countries with high tax rates can sometimes save a significant amount of money, especially on products like alcoholic beverages and tobacco.

translations.source: በፖይንት ማሪኦን እና ፌርሞንት መካከል ያለው ዝርጋታ፤ የቡፋሎ-ፒትስቡአርግ ፈጣን መንገዶች በተደጋጋሚ በተነጠለ መልከዓ ምድር እያለፉ በጣም አስቸጋሪ የመኪና መንጃ ሁኔታዎችን ያቀርባል።
translations.reference: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The stretch of road between Point Marion and Fairmont presents some of the most challenging driving conditions, as it involves frequent crossings of rivers along the Buffalo-Pittsburgh corridor.

translations.source: በክፍለሀገር መንገዶች ላይ ለማሽከርከር ካለመዱ ያለዎትን ጠንቃቃነት ይጠብቁ፡ ዳገታማ ቦታዎች ፣ ጠባብ መንገዶች እና የሾሉ ኩርባዎች በአብዛኛው አሉ።
translations.reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.hypothesis: When driving on rural roads, be extra cautious. You are likely to encounter uneven surfaces, narrow roads, and sharp curves.

translations.source: የተለጠፉት የፍጥነት ገደቦች በቀዳሚ እና ቀጣይ ክፍሎች — በተለምዶ 35-40 ማይል በሰዓት (56-64 ኪሜ/ሰ) —ውስጥ በሚያስታውቅ ሁኔታ ያነሱ ናቸው እና ካለማክበር ይልቅ ለእነርሱ በጥብቅ መገዛት በጣም ጠቃሚ ነው።
translations.reference: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.hypothesis: The posted speed limits, typically ranging from 35-40 miles per hour (56-64 km/h), are often reduced in specific sections of the road, and it is crucial to strictly adhere to these lower limits rather than risking a violation.

translations.source: በሚያስገርም ሁኔታ ግን፣ ከሌሎች ይልቅ መሥመሩ ከተዘረጋባቸው ቦታዎች ለምሳሌ ፔንስይልቫኒያ ዋይልድስ ይልቅ እዚህ የሞባይል አገልግሎት የበለጠ ጠንካራ ነው።
translations.reference: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: Interestingly, despite having a less extensive network compared to places like Pennsylvania Wilds, the mobile service here is actually stronger.

translations.source: የጀርመን ጣፋጭ ኬኮች በጣም አሪፍ ናቸው እና በባቫሪያ እንደ ደቡባዊ ጎረቤታቸው፣ ኦስትሪያ የበለጸጉ እና የተለያዩ ናቸው።
translations.reference: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: German pastries are incredibly delicious, and Bavaria, like its southern neighbor Austria, boasts a rich and diverse selection of them.

translations.source: አመቱን ሙሉ ፖሞች ወደ መጋገሪያዎች እየበሰሉ እና እንጆሪዎችና ፍሬዎች በበጋው እየታዩ የፍራፍሬ መጋገሪያዎች የተለመዱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.hypothesis: Fruit orchards are common, with apple trees bearing fruit throughout the year and berries and other fruits ripening during the summer months.

translations.source: ብዙ ጀርመን ውስጥ የተጋገሩ ሸቀጦች ለውዞችን፣ ሄዝል ፍሬዎችን እና ሌሎች የዛፍ ፍሬዎችንም ያካትታሉ። ታዋቂ ኬኮች ባብዛኛው ከአንድ የጠንካራ ቡና ፅዋ ጋር በልዩ ሁኔታ በደምብ ይጣመራል።
translations.reference: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.hypothesis: Many German-made products include nuts, hazelnuts, and other tree fruits. Popular cakes are often specially paired with a strong cup of coffee.

translations.source: ትንሽ ጣፋጭ ኬክዎችን ከፈለጉ፣ ግን በክልሉ ላይ በመመርኮዝ ምን እንደ ሆነ ለማወቅ ይሞክሩ በርሊነር ፓፋንኩቸን ወይም ክራፕፈን።
translations.reference: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: If you're looking for small, delicious cakes, try Berliner Pfannkuchen or Krapfen, and see what regional variations you can find.

translations.source: ከሪ ከስጋ ወይም አታክልት ጋር በእጽዋትና ቅመማ ቅመም ላይ የተመሰረተ ምግብ ነው።
translations.reference: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.hypothesis: "Keri" is a dish based on vegetables and spices, often served with meat or lentils.

translations.source: በቅመማ ቅመም የተቆላ ምግብ በፈሳሹ መጠን መሰረት “ደረቅ” ወይም “እርጥብ” ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.hypothesis: The consistency of a dish seasoned with spices can be described as "dry" or "moist" depending on the amount of liquid used.

translations.source: በሰሜናዊ ሕንድ እና ፓኪስታን ባሉ የመሃል አገር አካባቢዎች እርጎ በተለምዶ በከሪዎች ውስጥ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል፣ በደቡብ ህንድ እና በሌሎች በክፍለ አህጉሩ የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎች የኮኮናት ወተት አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል።
translations.reference: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.hypothesis: In central regions of northern India and Pakistan, clarified butter (ghee) is commonly used, while in southern India and other coastal areas of the subcontinent, coconut milk is often used instead.

translations.source: 17,000 አማራጭ ደሴቶችን በመያዝ፣ የኢንዶኔዢያ ምግብ በሃገሩ ዙሪያ የሚገኙ የክልል ሰፊ የምግብ ዓይነቶችን የሚሸፍን አጠቃላይ ቃል ነው።
translations.reference: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.hypothesis: With its 17,000 islands, Indonesia boasts a diverse culinary landscape that encompasses a wide range of regional cuisines throughout the country.

translations.source: ግን፣ ያለምንም ሌላ ቅጥያዎች ከተጠቀሙ፣ ቃሉ ከዋና ደሴት ጃቫ መሃል እና ምስራቃዊ ክፍሎች የመጣውን ምግብ ያመለክታል።
translations.reference: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.hypothesis: However, if no other modifiers are used, the word refers to food originating from the central and eastern regions of the main island of Java.

translations.source: አሁን ላይ በአርቺፔላጎ በሰፊው የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ የጃቫ የምግብ አሰራር ዘዴ በቀላሉ የተቀመሙ ምግቦችን፣ ጃቫውያን የሚወዱት ዋና ማጣፈጫዎች ኦቾሎኒ፣ ቃሪያዎች፣ ስኳር (በተለይ የጃቫውያን ኮኮናት ስኳር) እና የተለያዩ አሮማታዊ ቅመሞችን ያካትታል።
translations.reference: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.hypothesis: Currently, the Archipelago cuisine is widely available, and the traditional Javanese cooking methods often incorporate simple ingredients. Key components of Javanese cuisine include shallots, garlic, sugar (especially Javanese palm sugar), and various aromatic spices.

translations.source: እርካቦች በኮርቻው ጎን እና ጎን ለሚንጠለጠሉት የጋላቢ እግሮች መደገፊያ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.hypothesis: The galabs are supports that attach to the sides of the hull and provide stability to the boat.

translations.source: ለአሽከርካሪው የበለጠ መረጋጋትን ይሰጣሉ ነገር ግን የ አሽከርካሪው እግር በእነሱ ውስጥ ሊጣበቅ ስለሚችል የደህንነት ስጋቶች ሊኖሩት ይችላል።
translations.reference: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.hypothesis: While they provide the driver with more stability, they can pose safety risks because the driver's foot may get trapped inside them.

translations.source: ጋላቢው ከፈረሱ ከተወረወረ ነገር ግን አንድ እግር በእርካቡ ከተያዘ ፈረሱ በሚሮጥበት ጊዜ ሊጎተቱ ይችላሉ። አደጋን ለመቀነስ ብዙ የደኅንነት ቅድመ ጥንቃቄዎች መወሰድ አለባቸው።
translations.reference: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.hypothesis: When a rider falls from a horse, but one leg is caught in the stirrup, they can be dragged along the ground as the horse runs. To minimize the risk of injury, several safety precautions should be taken.

translations.source: በመጀመሪያ ብዙ ጋላቢዎች ሂል እና ለስላሳና እና ጠባብ ሶል ያላቸውን የጋላቢ ቦቲዎቻቸውን ያደርጋሉ።
translations.reference: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, many cobblers create boots with heels, smooth soles, and a narrow shape.

translations.source: ቀጣይ፣ አንዳንድ ኮርቻዎች፣ በተለይ የእንግሊዝ ኮርቻዎች፣ ሊወድቅ ባለ ጋላቢ ወደኋላ ሲሳብ የእርካብ ቆዳ ከኮርቻው ላይ እንዲወርድ የሚያስችሉ መከላከያ ዘንጎች አሏቸው።
translations.reference: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.hypothesis: Some types of corsets, particularly English corsets, have reinforcing stays that prevent the fabric from shifting and allow the corset to be pulled down over the hips.

translations.source: ኮቾሞ ሸለቆ - የደቡብ አሜሪካ ገዳይ ተብሎ የሚጠራው የቺሊ ዋና የአቀበት መውጣት መዳረሻ፣ በርካታ የተለያዩ የግራናይት ትልልቅ ግድግዳዎች እና ቋጥኞች አሉት።
translations.reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.hypothesis: Coquimbo Valley, often referred to as the "killer of South America," is a major climbing destination in Chile, featuring numerous large granite walls and cliffs.

translations.source: ከፍታ ቦታዎች እጅግ አስገራሚ እይታዎችን ያካትታሉ። ከሁሉም የዓለም ክፍሎች የመጡ ተንጠላጣዮች ማለቂያ በሌለው ግድግዳ መካከል አዳዲስ መንገዶችን በመፍጠር ላይ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.hypothesis: High-altitude locations offer breathtaking views. Travelers from all corners of the world are creating new pathways and experiences amidst the endless expanse.

translations.source: ስኪንግ እና በበረዶ መንሸራተትን የሚያካትቱ የቁልቁለት በረዶ ስፖርቶች ታዋቂ ስፖርቶች ስሆኑ በበረዶ በተሸፈነ መሬት ላይ ወደታች በሲኪ ወይም የበረዶ ሰሌዳ እግሮ ላይ ተጣብቆ ወደታች መንሸራተት ነው።
translations.reference: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing and snowboarding are popular winter sports that involve gliding down a snow-covered slope on skis or a snowboard.

translations.source: በረዶ መንሸራተት ሙሉ የእረፍት ወቅቶችን አንድ ቦታ ላይ በረዶ መንሸራተት ዙሪያ የሚያቅዱ፣ “የበረዶ ወዳጆች” ተብለው የሚታወቁ በጣም ብዙ አፍቃሪዎች ያሉት ዋና የጉብኝት ተግባር ነው።
translations.reference: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing is a popular recreational activity that attracts a large number of enthusiasts, often referred to as "ski lovers," who plan their vacations around opportunities to ski.

translations.source: በበረዶ ላይ የመንሸራተት ሐሳብ በጣም የቆየ ነው - ዋሻዎች ላይ የበረዶ ተንሸራታቾችን እንዲገልጹ የተሰሳሉት ስዕሎች እስከ 5000ቢሲ ድረስ ይደርሳሉ!
translations.reference: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: The idea of sledding is very old – depictions of people using sleds on snow date back as far as 5000 BC!

translations.source: እንደ ስፖርት የቁልቁለት በረዶ ላይ መንሸራተት ቢያንስ እስከ 17ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ወደኋላ ይሄዳል፣ እና በ1861 በኖርዌያኖች አውስትራሊያ ውስጥ የመጀመሪያው የመዝናኛ በረዶ ላይ መንሸራተት ክለብ ተከፍቶ ነበር።
translations.reference: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.hypothesis: The sport of skiing dates back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861, the first recreational ski club was established in Australia by Norwegians.

translations.source: በበረዶ መንሸራተቻ ቦርሳ ይዞ መጓዝ፡ ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ባክካንትሪ የበረዶ መንሸራተት፣ የበረዶ ጉብኝት ወይም የበረዶ ተራራ መውጣት ተብሎ ይጠራል።
translations.reference: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.hypothesis: Skiing with a backpack: This activity is commonly referred to as backcountry skiing, ski touring, or ski mountaineering.

translations.source: ብዙውን ጊዜ ከአልፕስ ዘይቤ የበረዶ ሸርተቴ ጉብኝት ወይም የተራራ ላይ ጉዞ ጋር የተገናኘ ቢሆንም እነዚህን አያካትትም፣ ሁለተኛው በጠባብ የመሬት አቀማመጥ ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ ሲሆኑ በጣም ጠንካራ የሆኑ የበረዶ ላይ መንሸራተቻ ረጃጅም እንጨቶች ወይም ፕላስቲኮችን እና ጫማዎች ያስፈልገዋል።
translations.reference: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.hypothesis: While often associated with alpine-style ice climbing or mountaineering, these activities are distinct. The latter takes place on steeper terrain and requires specialized equipment, including crampons (long, spiked metal or plastic attachments for boots) and appropriate footwear.

translations.source: የበረዶ መንሸራተቻ መንገዱን እንደ ተመሳሳይ የተራራ መውጫ መንገድ ያስቡት።
translations.reference: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.hypothesis: Think of a toboggan run as a similar type of downhill mountain trail.

translations.source: በጥሩ ሁኔታዎች ከእርምጃ በተወሰነ ደረጃ የበለጠ ርቀት ይሸፍኑ ይሆናል - ነገር ግን ከባድ ቦርሳ ሳይዙ በ ታረሰ መንገድ ላይ እምብዛም ሳይሆን አንዳንዴ የሀገር አቋራጭ ስኪ ፍጥነት ሊያገኙ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.hypothesis: Under ideal conditions, they might cover a slightly greater distance than a standard step, but even without carrying a heavy bag, you can sometimes achieve a decent pace on a flat surface, potentially even reaching a cross-country skiing speed.

translations.source: አውሮፓ በአንፃሩ አነስተኛ አህጉር ብትሆንም ብዙ እራሳቸውን የቻሉ ሀገራት አሏት። በመደበኛ ሁኔታዎች በተለያዩ ሀገራት መጓዝ ማለት፤ በቪዛ ማመልከቻዎች እና በፖስፖርት ቁጥጥር ብዙ ጊዜ ማለፍ አለብዎት ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: While Europe is not the smallest continent, it is home to many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, traveling between these countries often involves navigating visa applications and passport controls, which can be a lengthy process.

translations.source: የሸንገን ዞን በዚህ ረገድ ግን አንድ አገር ያህል ይሠራል።
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: The Shengen area, in this regard, functions almost like a single country.

translations.source: እዚ ዞን ውስጥ በአጠቃላይ በፓስፖርት ተቆጣጣሪዎች እና የፍተሻ ኬላዎችን ማለፍ ሳይኖርቦት ድንብሮችን መሻገር ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: Within this zone, you can cross the border without having to go through passport control or inspection checkpoints.

translations.source: በተመሳሳይ መልኩ፣ ሸንገን ቪዛ ካልዎት፣ ለሸንገን አባል ሃገራት በተናጠል ለቪዛ ማመልከት አይጠብቅብዎትም፣ ሰለዚህ ጊዜ፣ ገንዘብ እና ወረቀት ይቆጥባሉ።
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: Similarly, if you have a Schengen visa, you don't need to apply for a separate visa for each of the Schengen member countries, which saves you time, money, and paperwork.

translations.source: የተመረቱት አይነቶች ቅርስ የሆኑበት አለማቀፍ ትርጓሜ የለም። አንዳንድ የግብር ድርጅቶች ከ100 አመታት በላይ የሆኑ ሸቀጦችን እንደ ቅርሶች ይገልፃሉ።
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no universally accepted definition of what constitutes an "antique." Some tax authorities define antiques as items that are over 100 years old.

translations.source: ትርጓሜው፣ የእድሜ ወሰኑ ከአውሮፓ ይልቅ አጭር በሆነባቸው እንደ ሰሜን አሜሪካ ባሉ ቦታዎች፣ የጂኦግራፊ ልዩነቶች አሉት።
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The interpretation of lifespan varies geographically, with differences observed between regions like North America, where lifespans tend to be shorter compared to Europe.

translations.source: የእጅ-ጥበብ ምርቶች ምንም እንኳን በተመሳሳይ በጅምላ ከሚመረቱ ምርቶች በዕድሜ ያነሱ ቢሆኑም እንደ ጥንታዊ ሊገለፁ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: While handcrafted products are often perceived as being less modern than mass-produced items, they can still be considered contemporary.

translations.source: የአጋዘን እርባታ በሳሚ ውስጥ ጠቃሚ መተዳደሪያ ነው እና በንግዱ ዙሪያ ያለው ባህል ከሌሎች ሙያዎች ጋር ለብዙ ጠቃሚ ነው።
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: Agile methodology is a valuable management approach in software development, and the culture surrounding it is beneficial for many other industries as well.

translations.source: በተለምዶ ቢሆንም፣ ሁሉም ሳሚ ሁሉም በትልቅ ደረጃ የኤሮኤሽያ እና ሰሜን አሜሪካ አጋዘኖችን እርባታ አልተሳተፉም፣ ግን ዓሳ በማጥመድ፣ በአደን እና ተመሳሳይ ተግባሮች፣ ይኖሩ ነበር፣ የኤሮኤሽያ እና ሰሜን አሜሪካ አጋዘኖችን ለሸክም ነበር የሚጠቀሟቸው።
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: While it is commonly believed that all Sami people participated in large-scale reindeer herding in both Eurasia and North America, this is not entirely accurate. While some Sami people engaged in fishing, hunting, and other activities, they also utilized reindeer from Eurasia and North America for transportation and other purposes.

translations.source: ዛሬ ብዙ ሳሚ በዘመናዊ ንግዶች ውስጥ ይሰራል። በሳሚ አካባቢ በሳፕሚ ውስጥ ቱሪዝም ጠቃሚ ገቢ ነው።
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Today, many people work in the modern businesses located in the Sami region. Tourism is a significant source of income for the Sami community.

translations.source: በሰፊው ጥቅም ላይ ቢውልም፣ በተለይ ሮማኒ ባልሆኑ ሰዎች፣ ስለ ሮማኒ ሰዎች አሉታዊ አመለካከቶች እና ትክክል ያልሆኑ አስተሳሰቦች ጋር ባሉት ግንኙነቶች አማካኝነት “ጂፕሲ” የሚለው ቃል አፀያፊ እንደሆነ ይታሰባል።
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: While the word "gypsy" is widely used, it is considered offensive because it is often associated with negative stereotypes and misconceptions about the Romani people, particularly among those who are not familiar with Romani culture.

translations.source: የሚጎበኙት ሀገር ለጉዞ አማካሪዎች ተገዢ ከሆነ የጉዞ ጤና መድህንዎ ወይም የጉዞዎ ስረዛ ዋስትናዎ ተጽእኖ ሊያድርበት ይችላል።
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: Your travel health insurance or travel cancellation policy may be affected if the country you are visiting has specific regulations for travel agencies.

translations.source: ከራስዎ ሌላ የመንግስታትን ምክር ሊያማክሩም ሊፈልጉ ይችላሉ ነገር ግን የነሱ ምክር ለነሱ ዜጎች የተነደፈ ነው።
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: You might also seek advice from governments, but their advice is tailored to their own citizens.

translations.source: አንደ አንድ ምሳሌ፣ በመካከለኛው ምሥራቅ የአሜሪካ ዜጎች ከአውሮፓውያን ወይም ከአረቦች ይልቅ የተለዩ ሁኔታዎችን ሊጋፈጡ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.hypothesis: For example, American citizens in the Middle East may encounter different situations compared to Europeans or Arabs.

translations.source: መማክርት በአንድ ሃገር ውስጥ ያለ ፖለቲካዊ ሁኔታ አጭር ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.hypothesis: Teaching about the political situation within a country is merely a brief overview.

translations.source: የቀረቡት ዕይታዎች ከሌሎች የበለጠ ዝርዝር መረጃዎች ጋር ሲወዳደሩ የፈጠኑ፣ አጠቃላይ እይታ ያላቸው እና እጅግ የተቃለሉ ናቸው።
translations.reference: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.hypothesis: The perspectives presented are comprehensive, insightful, and highly detailed, offering a more nuanced understanding compared to other sources.

translations.source: ከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ ለማንኛውም ጉዳት፣ ከፍተኛ ማህበራዊ ረብሻ ወይም ህይወት ማጣትን የሚያስከትል አደገኛ የአየር ሁኔታ አጠቃላይ ስም ነው።
translations.reference: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.hypothesis: A severe weather event is a general term for dangerous weather conditions that can cause significant damage, widespread disruption, or loss of life.

translations.source: ከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ በላእም ላይ የትም ቦታ ሊከሰት ይችላል፣ እና በጂኦግራፊ፣ መሬት አቀማመጥና የከባቢ አየር ሁኔታዎችን ላይ ሊመሰረቱ ብዙ አይነቶች አሉት።
translations.reference: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the United States, and there are many different types, often determined by geographic location, terrain, and atmospheric conditions.

translations.source: የመብረቅ ነጎድጓዶች፣ አውሎ ነፋሶች፣ ውሃ አዙሪቶች እና ሳይክሎኖች እንደሆኑት ሁሉ ከፍተኛ ንፋሳት፣ በረዶ፣ ከመጠን ያለፈ ጥዱፍ ውርድ እና ሰደድ እሳት የከባድ አየር ሁኔታ ቅርጽና ውጤቶች ናቸው።
translations.reference: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.hypothesis: Just as lightning, thunderstorms, floods, and cyclones are examples of severe weather phenomena, strong winds, blizzards, excessive rainfall, and wildfires are also significant consequences of extreme weather conditions.

translations.source: ክልላዊ እና ወቅታዊ ከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ ክስተቶች የበረዶ ውሽንፍሮችን፣ የበረዶ አውሎ ነፋሶችን ፣የበረዶ ድንጋይ አውሎ ነፋሶችን እና የአቧራ አውሎ ነፋሶችን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.hypothesis: Regional and seasonal severe weather events include blizzards, ice storms, hail storms, and dust storms.

translations.source: ተጓዦች ከባድ አየር ሁኔታ ማንኛውንም የጉዞ እቅዶች ላይ ተፅእኖ ሊኖራቸው ስለሚችል አካባቢያቸው ላይ ተፅእኖ ከሚኖራቸው ከማንኛውም አደጋ እንዲጠነቀቁ በፅኑ ይመከራሉ።
translations.reference: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.hypothesis: Travelers are strongly advised to be aware of local weather conditions, as severe weather can significantly impact travel plans. They should take precautions to avoid any potential hazards that may arise due to the weather.

translations.source: የጦር ቀጠና ተደርጎ ሊቆጠር ወደሚችል ሃገር ለመጓዝ እያቀደ ያለ ማንም ሰው ሙያዊ ስልጠና ሊያገኝ ይገባል።
translations.reference: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone planning to travel to a country that could be considered a war zone should receive professional training.

translations.source: “አደገኛ አካባቢ ትምህርት” ብሎ በይነመረብ ላይ መፈለግ ምናልባት የአካባቢ ኩባንያ አድራሻ ሊያቀርብ ይችላል።
translations.reference: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.hypothesis: "Searching online for 'hazardous materials training' might lead you to a company that offers environmental services."

translations.source: ትምህርቱ በመደበኝነት እዚህ የተገለጹትን ጉዳዮች በሙሉ ባብዛኛው ከተግባራዊ ተሞክሮ ጋር በጣም በብዙ ዝርዝር ይሸፍናል።
translations.reference: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.hypothesis: The curriculum comprehensively covers all the topics outlined here, and it does so with a strong emphasis on practical experience.

translations.source: ትምህርቱ በመደበኝነት ከ2-5 ቀናት ይሆናል እና የሚና ጨዋታ፣ ብዙ የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ እና አንዳንድ ጊዜ የጦር ስልጠና ያካትታል።
translations.reference: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.hypothesis: The training typically lasts from 2 to 5 days and includes physical activities, extensive first aid training, and sometimes military drills.

translations.source: ከምድረ በዳ መዳንን የሚያመለክቱ መጻሕፍት እና መጽሔቶች የተለመዱ ናቸው ፣ ነገር ግን ከጦርነት ቀጠናዎች ጋር የሚነጋገሩ ጽሑፎች ጥቂቶች ናቸው።
translations.reference: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.hypothesis: While books and articles about desert survival are common, there are few texts that discuss experiences from war zones.

translations.source: በውጭ አገር የ ፆታ ማስተላለፍ የቀዶ ጥገና ዕቅድ ያወጣ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ለሚመጡት ጉዞ ትክክለኛ ሰነዶች ይዘው መሄዳቸውን ማረጋገጥ አለባቸው።
translations.reference: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.hypothesis: Passengers traveling abroad for gender affirmation surgery must ensure they have all the necessary documentation for their trip.

translations.source: መንግስታት ፓስፖርቶችን ካልተገለጸ ጾታ (X) ጋር ወይም ከተፈለገው ስም እና ጾታ ጋር ለማዛመድ የዘመኑ ሰነዶችን ለመስጠት ፈቃደኝነታቸው ይለያያል፡፡
translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: Governments vary in their willingness to issue updated documents, including passports, with a non-binary gender marker (X) or to allow individuals to align their name and gender with their preferred identity.

translations.source: የውጭ መንግስታት እነዚህን ሰነዶች የማክበር ፈቃደኝነት እንደዚያው በሰፊው ይለያያል።
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The willingness of foreign governments to respect these documents varies widely.

translations.source: በደህነነት ፍተሻ ነጥቦች ላይ ፍተሻዎች ከሴፕቴምበር 11, 2001 ዘመን በኋላ በጣም ጣልቃገብ ሆነዋል።
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: Since September 11, 2001, security checks at airports have become significantly more intrusive.

translations.source: ቅድመ-ቀዶ ጥገና ጾታ ቀያሪ ሰዎች ግላዊነታቸው እና ክብራቸው እንደተጠበቀ በመፈተሻዎቹ እንዲያልፉ መጠበቅ የለባቸውም።
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: Pre-operative transgender individuals should not be subjected to invasive examinations that compromise their privacy and dignity.

translations.source: ሪፕ ሞገዶች ከዳርቻው የሚመጣው ሞገድ ምላሽ ፍሰቶች ናቸው፣ ብዙ ጊዜ በሪፍ ወይም በተመሳሳዩ።
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: Rip currents are powerful, narrow channels of water that flow away from the shore, often originating from a reef or similar structure.

translations.source: በውሃ ውስጥ ባለው አቀማመጥ ምክንያት የመመለሻው ፍሰት በጥቂቶች ጥልቀት ባላቸው ክፍሎች ያተኮረ ነው ፣ እና ወደ ጥልቅ ውሃ የሚወስድ ፈጣን ጎርፍ እዚያ ሊፈጠር ይችላል።
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the way the water is distributed, the return flow is concentrated in the shallower areas, and a rapid current leading to deeper water can be generated there.

translations.source: ብዙ ሞቶች፣ ሊሆን በማይችለው፣ ከሞገዱ በተቃራኒ ለመዋኘት በመሞከር ድካም ምክንያት ይከሰታሉ።
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: Many deaths, which seem impossible, are actually caused by exhaustion resulting from trying to swim against the current.

translations.source: ካሉበት እንደወጡ ወዲያውኑ ወደኋላ መዋኘት ከተለመደው የበለጠ ከባድ አይደለም።
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: It's not significantly more difficult to reverse direction immediately after starting forward, than it is to reverse direction under normal circumstances.

translations.source: እንደገና ካልተያዙበት ቦታ ለመፈለግ ይሞክሩ ወይም በችሎታዎ ላይ በመመርኮዝ እና መታየቶ ላይ በመመርኮዝ መዳንን ሊጠብቁ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: Try to retrace your steps to the place where you last had it, or you may be able to find it by searching based on your memory of where you were and what you were doing.

translations.source: የዳግም መግባት ድንጋጤ ከባህል ድንጋጤ (ያለው የጫጉላ ደረጃ ትንሽ ነው) ቀድሞ ይመጣል፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ ይቆያል እና የበለጠ ከባድ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: Re-entry shock often comes before culture shock (though the latter can also be a factor), lasts longer, and can be more intense.

translations.source: ከአዲሱ ባህል ለመላመድ ቀላል ጊዜ የነበራቸው ተጓዞች አንዳንድ ጊዜ ከነባር ባህላቸው ጋር ዳግም ለመለማመድ በተለየ መልኩ ሊቸገሩ ይችላል።
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, travelers who easily adapt to a new culture may find it challenging to readjust to their own culture upon returning home.

translations.source: ውጭ ከኖሩ በኋላ ወደቤት ሲመለሱ ለአዲሱ ባህል ለምደዋል እና የቤትዎን ባህል አንዳንድ ልማዶችዎን አጥተዋል።
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: After living abroad, when people return home, they have learned a new culture and may have forgotten some of the customs and traditions of their own home.

translations.source: በመጀመሪያ ወደ ውጭ አገር ሲሄዱ ተጓዦች ከአዲሱ ሀገር ከሁኔታዎች ጋር መላመድ እንዳለባቸው ስለሚያወቅቁ ሰዎች ምናልባት ታጋሽ እና አስተዋይ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, travelers who went abroad were likely resilient and adaptable, as they understood the need to adjust to a new country and its conditions.

translations.source: ትዕግሥትና ማስተዋል ወደ አገራቸው ለሚመለሱ ተጓዦች አስፈላጊ መሆናቸውንም ሰዎች አይረዱም።
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: People often fail to realize the importance of patience and understanding for travelers returning to their home country.

translations.source: የፒራሚድ ድምፁ እና የብርሃን ትርኢቱ በአካባቢው ለልጆች በጣም ተወዳጅ ከሆኑ ነገሮች አንዱ ነው።
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: The pyramid's sound and light show is one of the most popular attractions for children in the area.

translations.source: ፒራሚዶቹን በጨለማ ሊያዩአቸው ይችላሉ እና ትርኢቱ ከመጀመሩ በፊት በፀጥታ ሊያዩአቸው ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.hypothesis: You can view the pyramids in the dark, and you can observe them in silence before the show begins.

translations.source: ብዙውን ጊዜ እዚህ የቱሪስቶች እና የሻጮች ድምጽ ይሰማሉ። የድምፅ እና የብርሃኑ ታሪክ ልክ እንደ የተረት መጽሐፍ ነው።
translations.reference: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.hypothesis: Often, you can hear the voices of tourists and vendors here. The story of the sounds and lights is like a fairytale.

translations.source: ድብቁ ሰው እንደ በስተጀርባ ዳራ እና እንደ ረጅም ታሪክ ተራኪ የተሰራ ነው፡፡
translations.reference: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.hypothesis: A secretive person is like a background scene and a long, winding road.

translations.source: ትዕይንቶቹ ፒራሚዶቹ ላይ ይታያሉ እና የተለየዩ ፒራሚዶች ይበራሉ።
translations.reference: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.hypothesis: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids, and different pyramids are illuminated.

translations.source: በ1819 የተገኙት፣ ደቡብ ሼትላንድ ደሴቶች፣ በብዙ ሀገራት የኔ ነው የሚባሉ እና በ2020 አስራ ስድስቱ የሚሰሩ የሆኑ፣ ብዙ ጣቢያዎች አሏቸው።
translations.reference: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.hypothesis: The South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by numerous countries and, as of 2020, have over sixteen research stations established there.

translations.source: ደሴቶቹ ባሕረ ሰላጤው በስተ ሰሜን 120 ኪ.ሜ ርቀት ላይ ይገኛሉ። ትልቁ ደሴት የንጉስ ጆርጅ ደሴት ሲሆን ቪላ ላስ ኤስትራላስ ሰፍረውበታል።
translations.reference: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: The islands are located approximately 120 kilometers north of the Mediterranean Sea. The largest island is King George Island, which is home to the Villa Las Estrellas settlement.

translations.source: ሌሎቹ ደግሞ ሊቪንግስተን ደሴት እና ዲሴፕሽን በጎርፍ የተጥለቀለቀው እሳተ ገሞራ አስደናቂ ተፈጥሮአዊ ወደብ የሚያቀርቡበትን ስፍራ ይገኙበታል።
translations.reference: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.hypothesis: Some of these locations offer stunning natural harbors, including Livingston Island and the area around Deception Island, which was formed by a volcanic eruption.

translations.source: ኤሪስወርዝ ላንድ በ ቤሊንግሿሰን ባህር የተከበበ በደቡብ ፔኑንስላ የሚገኝ ግዛት ነው።
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.hypothesis: Ariesworth Land is a region located on the southern peninsula, bordered by the Bellingesen Sea.

translations.source: እዚህ የባህር ሰላጤው ተራራዎች ወደ አምባው ይጣመራሉ፣ ከዚያ በሚኒሶታ ግግር በረዶ የሚከፈሉት የኢልስዎርዝ ተራራዎችን 360 ኬሜ ሰንሰለት ለመፍጠር እንደገና ይወጣሉ።
translations.reference: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: Here, the coastal mountains rise sharply, then descend into the vast expanse of the Minnesota prairie before rising again to form the 360-kilometer-long Ilsworth mountain range.

translations.source: ሰሜናዊው ክፍል ወይም ሰንቲነል ሬንጅ በ 4892ሜ ከፍታ የቪንሰን ተራራ የአንታርቲካን ትልልቅ ተራሮች የያዘውን ቪንሰን ማሲፍ ይዟል።
translations.reference: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: The northern part, or Sentinel Range, with its highest peak, Mount Vinson, at 4,892 meters, is part of the Vinson Massif, which contains some of the largest mountains in Antarctica.

translations.source: ከስልክ ሽፋን ውጭ በሆኑ በሩቅ አካባቢዎች የሳተላይት ስልክ ብቸኛ አማራጭዎ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.hypothesis: In remote areas where cellular service is unavailable, a satellite phone may be your only option for communication.

translations.source: የሳተላይት ስልክ ደወል ስታደርግ ሳተላይቱን በቀጥታ መስመር ለማየት እንዲቻል ከቤት ውጭ ግልጽ ሆነው በሚታዩ መስመሮች ላይ መሆን ስላለብህ፣ በጠቅላላው የተንቀሳቃሽ ስልክ የተንቀሳቃሽ ስልክ መተኪያ አይደለም።
translations.reference: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.hypothesis: When making a satellite phone call, you need to be in a clear, open area with a direct line of sight to the satellite so that the signal can be transmitted. Therefore, a satellite phone is not a replacement for a regular mobile phone.

translations.source: አገልግሎቱ በተደጋጋሚ በማጓጓዛ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል የመዝናኛ የእጅ ሙያ እና የርቀት ውሂብ እና የድምፅ ፍላጎት የሚያስፈልጋቸው ጉዞዎችን ጨምሮ።
translations.reference: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.hypothesis: The service is frequently used for transportation purposes, including trips that require entertainment, hands-free operation, and remote data and voice communication.

translations.source: የአከባቢዎ የስልክ አገልግሎት አቅራቢ ወደዚህ አገልግሎት ስለ ማገናኘት ተጨማሪ መረጃ ለመስጠት መቻል አለበት።
translations.reference: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.hypothesis: Your local phone service provider should be able to provide you with more information about connecting to this service.

translations.source: የዓመት-እረፍት ለሚያቅዱ ሰዎች ይበልጥ እየጨመረ የሄደው አማራጭ ጉዞ መሄድ እና መማር ነው።
translations.reference: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.hypothesis: For those planning a sabbatical, experiential travel and learning are increasingly popular options.

translations.source: ይህ ትምህርታቸውን ሳያበላሽ ከዩኒቨርሲቲ በፊት አንድ አመት እንዲወስዱ ስለሚፈቅድ በተለየ በትምህርት ቤት አቋራጮች ታዋቂ ነው።
translations.reference: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.hypothesis: This program is particularly popular with school counselors because it allows students to take a gap year before university without interrupting their education.

translations.source: በብዙ ሁኔታዎች ለአንድ ክፍት-አመት ትምህርት በውጭ ሃገር መመዝገብ በተግባር በትውልድ ሃገርዎ ወደ ከፍተኛ ትምህርት የመግባት እድልዎትን ሊያሻሽል ይችላል።
translations.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.hypothesis: In many cases, enrolling in a year-long study abroad program can actually improve your chances of getting into a higher education institution in your home country.

translations.source: በእነዚህ የትምህርት መርሃ ግብሮች ውስጥ ለመመዝገብ በአይነተኝነት የትምህርት ክፍያ ይኖራል።
translations.reference: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.hypothesis: There will be a registration fee for enrolling in these educational programs.

translations.source: ፊንላንድ ምርጥ የመርከብ መዳረሻ ናት። “የሺህ ሃይቆች ምድር”፣ ሃይቆች ውስጥ እና የባህር ዳርቻ አርቺፔላጎዎች ውስጥ በሺህ የሚቆጠሩ ደሴቶችም አሏት።
translations.reference: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
