translations.hypothesis: Finland is a fantastic destination for boating. Known as the "Land of a Thousand Lakes," it boasts thousands of lakes and numerous archipelagoes along its coastline.

translations.source: በደሴቶች ስብስብ እና በሃይቆች ላይ የግድ ጀልባ አያስፈልጎትም።
translations.reference: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.hypothesis: You don't necessarily need a boat to explore a group of islands or coastal areas.

translations.source: የጠረፍ እጅብ ደሴቶች እና ትልልቆቹ ሃይቆች ለማንኛውም መርከብ በበቂ ሁኔታ ትልቅ ቢሆኑም ትንሽ ጀልባዎች ወይም ትንሽ ጀልባ እንኳ የተለየ ተሞክሮ ያቀርባሉ።
translations.reference: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.hypothesis: While the larger islands and waterways are suitable for any type of vessel, even small boats or dinghies can offer a unique experience.

translations.source: በጀልባ መዝናናት በፊንላንድ ውስጥ አገር አቀፍ የጊዜ ማሳለፊያ ሲሆን አንድ ጀልባዋ ለሰባት ወይም ስምንት ሰዎች ነው።
translations.reference: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.hypothesis: Sauna experiences are a popular national pastime in Finland, and a typical sauna can accommodate seven or eight people.

translations.source: ይህ በኖርዌይ፣ ስዊድን፣ እና ኒው ዚላንድ ይዛመዳል፣ ነገር ግን አለበለዚያ በጣም ልዩ (ምሳ. በኔዘርላንድ ቁጥሩ አንድ ለ አርባ ነው)።
translations.reference: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.hypothesis: This is common in Norway, Sweden, and New Zealand, but otherwise it is quite rare (for example, the ratio in the Netherlands is one in forty).

translations.source: አብዛኞቹ ልዩ የቦልቲክ መርከቦች በሩሲያ ኤስቲ ፒተርስበርግ የተራዘመ ቆይታ ይኖራቸዋል።
translations.reference: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the specialized Baltic ships will have an extended stay in the Russian port of St. Petersburg.

translations.source: ይህ ማለት ማታ እየተመለሱና መርከቧ ላይ እየተኙ ለጥንድ ሙሉ ቀናት ታሪካዊ ከተማዋን መጎብኘት ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.hypothesis: This means that you can spend a couple of full days exploring the historic city while returning to the ship each evening to sleep.

translations.source: ወደ ባህር ዳርቻ የሚሄዱት የመርከብ ሰሌዳ አጭር ጉዞዎች ብቻ ተጠቅመው ከሆነ፤ የተለየ ቪዛ አያስፈልግዎትም (ከ2009 ጀምሮ)።
translations.reference: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.hypothesis: If your trips to the coast involve only short ferry rides, you do not require a separate visa (since 2009).

translations.source: አንዳንድ መርከቦች ብሮሸሮች ውስጥ ጀርመን በርሊንን ያካትታሉ። ከላይ ባለው ካርታ ማየት እንደሚችሉት በርሊን ባህሩ አካባቢ የለችም እና የከተማዋ ጉብኝት በመርከብ ጉዞው ዋጋ ላይ አልተካተተም።
translations.reference: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the cruises include a stop in Bremerhaven, Germany. As you can see on the map above, Berlin is not located near the coast, and the cost of the cruise does not include a visit to the city.

translations.source: በተለይ ከዚያ በፊት በአውሮፕላን በረው የማያውቁ ከሆነ ወይም አንድ አሰቃቂ ሁኔታ አጋጥሟቸው የሚያውቅ ከሆነ፣ በአውሮፕላን መጓዝ ከብዙ እድሜ እና ቦታ ላይ ለመጡ ሰዎች አስፈሪ ተሞክሮ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.hypothesis: For some people, especially those who have never flown before or who have had a negative experience with air travel, flying can be a daunting experience, regardless of their age or where they are coming from.

translations.source: እርሱ የሚያሳፍር ነገር አይደለም፤ በጣም ብዙ ሰዎች ካሏቸው ከሌሎች ነገሮች ግላዊ ፍርሃቶችና አለመውደዶች የተለየ አይደለም።
translations.reference: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.hypothesis: It's not something to be ashamed of; it's no different than the personal fears and dislikes that many people have.

translations.source: ለአንዳንድ ሰዎች፣ አውሮፕላን እንዴት እንደሚሰራ እና በበረራ ወቅት ምንም እንደሚከሰት አንዳንድ ነገርን መረዳት በማይታወቀው ወይም ቁጥጥር ውስጥ ባልሆነ ነገር ላይ የተመሰረተ ፍርሃትን ለመጋፈጥ ሊረዳ ይችላል።
translations.reference: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.hypothesis: For some people, understanding how an airplane works and what happens during a flight can help them confront a fear rooted in the unknown or in a perceived lack of control.

translations.source: የማጓጓዣ ኩባንያዎች ነገሮችን በፍጥነት ለማቅረብ በደንብ ይከፈላሉ። ባብዛኛው ጊዜ ለንግድ ሰነዶች፣ ግብይይት ወይም ለአስቸኳይ ጥገና መለዋወጫ እቃዎች በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው።
translations.reference: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.hypothesis: Transportation companies charge higher rates to ensure the prompt delivery of goods. This is often crucial for business documents, transactions, or the delivery of spare parts needed for urgent repairs.

translations.source: በአንዳንድ መንገዶች ላይ ትላልቆቹ ኩባንያዎች የራሳቸው አውሮፕላኖች አሏቸው፣ ነገር ግን ለሌሎች መንገዶች እና ትናንሽ ድርጅቶች ችግር ነበር።
translations.reference: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.hypothesis: In some cases, large companies have their own airplanes, but this presents a problem for other routes and smaller organizations.

translations.source: ዕቃዎችን በአውሮፕላን ጭነት ከላኩ፣ በአንዳንድ መንገዶች ላይ በማራገፍ ሂደቱ እና ቀረጥ ውስጥ ለማለፍ የተወሰኑ ቀናት ሊፈጅ ይችላል።
translations.reference: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.hypothesis: When shipping goods by air freight, the process can take several days, including transit time and customs clearance.

translations.source: በፍጥነት እንዲያልፍ ለማድረግ ብቸኛው መንገድ እንደተረጋገጠ ጓዝ መላክ ነበር። የአየር መንገድ ደንብ ሻንጣ ያለ ተሳፋሪ እንዲልኩ አይፈቅድላቸውም፣ በዚህ ጊዜ ነው እርስዎ የሚያስፈልጉት።
translations.reference: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.hypothesis: The only way to ensure it arrived quickly was to send it as checked baggage. Airlines don't allow unaccompanied luggage to be shipped, which is why you need to be there.

translations.source: በፈርስት ክላስ ወይም በቢዝነስ ክላስ ለመብረር ግልፁ መንገድ ለተጠቀሰው መብት (ወይም፣ ኩባንያዎን ለእርስዎ እንዲያደርግልዎ የሚያደርጉት) ብዙ ገንዘብን መትፋት ነው።
translations.reference: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.hypothesis: Flying first class or business class is a significant expense, requiring a substantial investment to secure that level of service (or, to have your company cover the cost for you).

translations.source: ሆኖም ግን፣ ይህ ርካሽ ሆኖ አይመጣም፡ በቀላሉ ብናስበው፣ ለንግዱ ከመደበኛው የኢኮኖሚ ታሪፍ ይልቅ እስከ አራት እጥፍ ድረስ ሊከፍሉ ይችላሉ፣ ለፈርስት ክላስ ደግሞ እስከ አስራ አንድ እጥፍ ድረስ!
translations.reference: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.hypothesis: However, this doesn't necessarily mean it's cheap. In fact, when you consider it, businesses could be paying up to four times the standard economic rate, and for first-class service, potentially up to eleven times the normal price!

translations.source: በአጠቃላይ ለመናገር ከኤ ወደ ቢ ለሚደረጉ ቀጥታ በረራዎች የቢዝነስ ወይም የመጀመሪያ ክፍል ወንበሮች ላይ ቅናሽ መፈለግ ሁላ ጥቅም የለውም።
translations.reference: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.hypothesis: In general, when it comes to direct flights from point A to point B, it's usually not worth it to look for discounts on business or first-class seats.

translations.source: የአየር መንገዶች በፍጥነትና በምቾት የሆነ ቦታ ለመድረስ ልዩ መብት ከፍተኛ ዶላር ለመክፈል ፈቃደኛ የሆኑ የተወሰነ የበራሪዎች ዋና ቡድን እንዳለ በደምብ ስለሚያውቁ በዛ መሰረት ያስከፍላሉ።
translations.reference: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.hypothesis: Airlines are acutely aware that there is a specific group of travelers who are willing to pay a premium for the convenience and speed of air travel, and they cater to this group accordingly.

translations.source: የሞልዶቫ ዋና ከተማ ቺሲናዉ ነው። የአካባቢው ቋንቋ ሮማኒያኛ ነው፣ ነገር ግን ራሺያኛ በስፋት ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል።
translations.reference: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is also widely spoken.

translations.source: ሞልዶቫ በብሄር ግጭት የተሰቃየች ባለብዙ ብሄር ሪፐብሊክ ናት።
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has been plagued by ethnic conflicts.

translations.source: በ 1994 ይህ ግጭት የራሱ መንግስት እና ምንዛሪ ያለው ነገር ግን በማንኛውም የUN አባል ሀገር ዕውቅና ያላገኘው በምስራቅ ሞልዶቫ የሚገኘውን እራሱን ትራንስንስትሪያ ሪፑብሊክ ብሎ የሚጠራውን ቀጠና እንዲፈጠር አደረገ።
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of a region in eastern Moldova called Transnistria, which declared itself the Transnistrian Republic. It had its own government and currency, but was not recognized by any UN member state.

translations.source: የፖለቲካ ስምምነቶች ውድቀት እንዳለ ሆኖ በነዚያ ሁለት የሞልዶቫ ክፍሎች መካከል የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነቶች ዳግም ተቋቁመዋል።
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the breakdown of political agreements, economic ties have been re-established between those two regions of Moldova.

translations.source: ሞልዶቫ ውስጥ ዋናው ሃይማኖት ኦርቶዶክስ ክርስትና ነው።
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The predominant religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christianity.

translations.source: ኢዝሚር ወደ 3.7 ሚሊዮን አካባቢ የሚሆን ህዝብ ይዛ በቱርክ ውስጥ ሶስተኛ ትልቋ ከተማ ናት፣ ከኢስታንቡል ቀጥላ ሁለተኛ ትልቋ ወደብ፣ እንዲሁም በጣም ጥሩ የመጓጓዣ ማእከል ናት።
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir, with a population of approximately 3.7 million, is the third-largest city in Turkey. It is the second-largest port in the country after Istanbul, and also a major transportation hub.

translations.source: አንዴ በስምይርና ጥንታዊ ከተማ አሁን ዘመናዊ ከተማ የሆነው፣ ያደገ እና የተጨናነቀ የንግድ ቦታ ነው፤ በተራሮች የተከበበ ትልቅ ባሕረ ሰላጤ ነበረ።
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: Once a small and ancient city, it is now a modern and bustling commercial center, a large metropolis nestled amidst mountains and overlooking a vast sea.

translations.source: ሰፋፊ መንገዶቹ፣ የመስታወት ፊት ያላቸው ህንፃዎች እና ዘመናዊ የመገባያያ ማእከላት በባህላዊ ቀይ የተነጠፉ ጣሪያዎች፣ 18ኛ ክፍለ ዘመን ገበያ እና ያረጁ መስጊዶች እና ቤተ ክርስቲያኖች ነጠብጣብ የተደረጉ ናቸው፣ ቢሆንም ከተማዋ ከባህላዊ ቱርክ ይልቅ የበለጠ የሜድትራኒያን አውሮፓ ድባብ አላት።
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The city boasts wide, well-maintained roads, buildings with glass facades, and modern transportation hubs. However, it also features traditional red-tiled roofs, an 18th-century market, and scattered mosques and churches. While it retains some of its traditional Turkish character, the city has a stronger Mediterranean European influence.

translations.source: የሃልዳርስቪክ መንደር በአቅራቢያው ያለ የኢስቱርቮይ ደሴት እይታዎችን ያቀርባል እና ያልተለመደ ጎነ-ስምንት ቤተ-ክርስቲያን አለው።
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The village of Haldorsvík offers views of the nearby island of Streymoy and features a unique octagonal church.

translations.source: በቤተ-ክርስቲያን ግቢው ውስጥ በአንዳንድ መቃብሮች ላይ አስገራሚ የእርግቦች የእምነበረድ ቅርጽ-ቅርጾች አሉ።
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: Within the church grounds, there are some tombs that feature fascinating and intricate carvings of insects.

translations.source: ትኩረት ወደ ሚስብ አስገራሚ መንደሩ መጓዝ ግማሽ ሰዓት ያህል ዋጋ አለው።
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: The journey to the fascinating city of Misawa cost approximately half an hour.

translations.source: ወደ ሰሜን እና በቀላሉ ሊደርስ በማይችሉት ሳንቲራ የምትባል ከተማ አስደናቂ ፍቅር ያለው እና አስገራሚ በሆነችው በሲንቲራ ከተማ በሎርድ ባይሮን ከተመዘገበ አስደናቂ ታሪክ በኋላ ለባዕድ አገር ሰዎች ታዋቂ ሆነች፡፡
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: The city of Sintra, with its stunning beauty and fascinating history, is located north of Lisbon and is easily accessible. It became famous among foreign visitors after being described by Lord Byron, and its captivating charm continues to draw people in.

translations.source: ስኮቱርብ ባስ 403 ካቦ ዳ ሮካ በመቆም በመደበኛነት ወደ ሲናትራ ይጓዛል።
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: The Sciturp Bus 403 Cabo da Roca regularly travels to Sintra.

translations.source: ወደ ሰሜን ደግሞ በዓለም ዙሪያ ዝነኛ የማሪያ ስርዓቶች የሚደረጉበትን ቦታ፣ እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም (መቅደስ) ይጎብኙ።
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: To the north, visit the Church of Our Lady Mary, a renowned pilgrimage site where Marian devotions are held.

translations.source: ያስታውሱ እርስዎ በዋናነት ትልቅ የመቃብር ሥፍራን እየጎበኙ እንደሆነ እና እንዲሁም ለብዙ የዓለም ህዝብ በስሌት የማይለካ ትርጉም ያለው ጣቢያ ነው።
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: Please remember that you are primarily visiting a large cemetery, and it is also a site of immeasurable significance to many people around the world.

translations.source: እዚህ የነበራቸውን ጊዜ ተቋቁመው በሕይወት ያሉ ብዙ ወንዶችና ሴቶች በሕይወት የተረፉ አሁንም አሉ፣ እና እዚያ የተገደሉ ወይም እስከሚሞቱ ድረስ ስራ የሰሩ የሚወዷቸው ሰዎች የነበሯቸው ብዙዎች፣ አይሁዶች እና አይሁድ ያልሆኑ በተመሳሳይ፡፡
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: Many men and women who were present there, and who are still alive, remember those times. There were also many who were killed or who worked and lived there until their deaths, both Jews and non-Jews.

translations.source: እባክዎን ቦታውን በሙሉ ተገቢነት፣ እርጋታ እና አክብሮት ይመልከቱ። ስለ እልቂቱ ወይም ናዚዎች አይቀልዱ።
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please treat the space with the utmost respect, dignity, and reverence. Do not make light of the tragedy or the Nazis.

translations.source: በህንፃ መዋቅሮች ላይ የሚሳሉ ስእሎችና ጽሁፎች በመቧጨር ወይም ምልክት በማድረግ ጣቢያውን አያጥፉ፡፡
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: The website is not damaged by images or text applied to building structures through painting or marking.

translations.source: የባርሴሎና ኦፊሲያላዊ ቋንቋዎች ካታላን እና እስጳኛ ናቸው። ግማሽ የሚሆኑት ካታላን መናገር ይመርጣሉ እና ሁሉም ሰው ሊባል በሚችል ሁኔታ እስጳኛ ይውቃል።
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. Approximately half of the population prefers to speak Catalan, while everyone understands Spanish to a degree that allows for communication.

translations.source: ነገር ግን ፣ ብዙ ምልክቶች በካታላን ብቻ ይመለከታሉ፤ ምክንያቱም በህግ የተመሰረተ የመጀመሪያው የይፋ ቋንቋ ነው።
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: However, many signs are only displayed in Catalan because it is the first official language established by law.

translations.source: ሆኖም፣ እስጳኛም በህዝብ መጓጓዣና በሌሎች ተቋማት ውስጥ በስፋት ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል።
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: However, Spanish is also widely used in public transportation and other institutions.

translations.source: ሜትሮ ውስጥ መደበኛ ማስታወቂያዎች የሚሰሩት በካታላን ብቻ ነው፣ ነገር ግን ያልታቀዱ መዛባቶች በራሥሠር ስርአት እስጳኛን፣ እንግሊዝኛን፣ ፈረንሳይኛን፣ አረበኛን እና ጃፓንኛን በሚያጠቃልሉ በተለያዩ ቋንቋዎች ይተዋወቃሉ።
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: While the standard announcements in the metro system are only in Catalan, the system also uses a variety of languages, including Spanish, English, French, Arabic, and Japanese, to communicate important information to passengers.

translations.source: የፓሪስ ሰዎች ራስ ወዳድ፣ ትዕቢተኛ እና እብሪተኛ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: The people of Paris were selfish, arrogant, and conceited.

translations.source: ይህ ባብዛኛው የተሳሳተ አመለካከት ብቻ ሆኖ ሳለ ፓሪስ ውስጥ ለመስማማት ምርጡ መንገድ ”ቤን ኤሌቭ” (በጥሩ እንዳደገ) ሰው በመስራት አሁንም በእርስዎ ምርጥ ባህሪ ላይ ነው።
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: While this is largely a misguided perspective, the best way to navigate disagreements in Paris is to act like a "bon élève" (a well-behaved person) and maintain your best manners.

translations.source: መሰረታዊ ጨዋነቶችን ካሳዩ የፓሪሳዊያን ድንገተኛ ውጫዊ ባህሪ በፍጥነት ይተናል።
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: The Parisians' initial display of basic manners quickly gave way to a sudden and noticeable change in behavior.

translations.source: የፕሊትቫይስ ሐይቆች ብሔራዊ ፓርክ በጣም በደን የተሸፈነ ሲሆን በዋነኝነት በቢች፣ ስፕሩስ እና ፊር በተባሉት ዛፎች የሚገኝ ሲሆን የአልፓይን እና የሜዲትራኒያን እፅዋት ድብልቅ ነው።
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: Plitvice Lakes National Park is heavily forested, primarily with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a diverse mix of alpine and Mediterranean flora.

translations.source: ባሉት ትናንሽ የአየር ጸባይ ልዩነት፣ በተለያየ አፈር እና በከፍታ ምክንያት በውስጡ የተለያዩ የእፅዋት ማህበረሰቦች አሉት።
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the seemingly small variations in climate, the area contains diverse plant communities due to differences in soil types and altitude.

translations.source: አካባቢው እጅግ በጣም ለተለያዩ የእንስሳትና የወፍ ዝርያዎች መኖሪያም ነው።
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: The area is home to a wide variety of animal and bird species.

translations.source: እንደ አውሮፓዊ ቡናማ ድብ፣ ተኩላ፣ ንስር፣ ጉጉት፣ ሊንክስ፣ የዱር ድመት እና ካፐርኬሊ ያሉ ብርቅ እንስስ ከብዙ የተለመዱ ዝርያዎች ጋር እዚያ ሊገኙ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: Similar to European brown bears, lynx, eagles, owls, wildcats, and capercaillie, a variety of other wildlife species can be found in the area, alongside more common animals.

translations.source: ገዳማቱን ሲጎበኙ ሴቶች ጉልበቶቻቸውን የሚሸፍኑ ቀሚሶችን እንዲለብሱ ይጠበቅባቸዋል እና ትካሻዎቻቸውንም መሸፈን አለባቸው።
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: When visiting monasteries, women are required to wear long-sleeved shirts that cover their shoulders, and they must also cover their heads.

translations.source: አብዛኞቹ ገዳማት ሳይዘጋጁ ለመጡ ሴቶች መጠቅለያዎችን ያቀርባሉ፣ ግን የራስዎትን በተለይ ብሩህ ቀለማት ያሉት ካመጡ መግቢያው ላይ ከመነኩሴው ወይም መነኩሴዋ ፈገግታ ያገኛሉ።።
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Most monasteries provide robes for women who arrive without their own, but they are particularly pleased when visitors, especially those wearing bright colors, arrive already dressed appropriately.

translations.source: በተመሳሳይ መንገድ ወንዶችም ጉልበቶቻቸውን የሚሸፍኑ ሱሪዎችን እንዲለብሱ ይጠበቅባቸዋል።
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: Similarly, men are also expected to wear trousers that cover their thighs.

translations.source: ይህም መግቢያው ላይ ከክምችቱ ሊዋስ ይችላል ግን ያ ልብስ ከእያንዳንዱ ተጠቃሚ በኋላ አይታጠብም ስለዚህ እነዚህን ቀሚሶች ሲለብሱ ምቾት ላይሰማዎት ይችላል። አንድ መጠን ለሁሉም ወንዶች ይሆናል!
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: While this introductory garment might feel stiff initially, it won't require washing after each use. You might find these shirts comfortable to wear. One size fits all men!

translations.source: ማጆርካን የምግብ አሰራር ዘዴ፣ ከሜዲትራኒያን ጋር ይመሳሰላል፣ ዳቦ፣ አትክልቶች እና ስጋ (በተለየ የአሳማ ስጋ) ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን እና በጠቅላላው ላይ የወይራ ዘይትን ይጠቀማል።
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: The culinary traditions of Majorca are similar to those of the Mediterranean, focusing on bread, vegetables, and meat (particularly pork), and using olive oil extensively.

translations.source: ቀለል ያለ ተወዳጅ እራት፣ በተለይም በበጋ ወቅት፣ የፓ አም ኦሊ ነው፡- ዳቦ ከወይራ ዘይት ጋር፣ ቲማቲም እና ማንኛውም የተገኘው ቅመም እንደ አይብ፣ ቱናፊሽ፣ ወዘተ።
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: A simple and popular dish, especially during the summer, is "Pa Am Oli." It consists of bread served with a mixture of olive oil, tomatoes, and any available seasonings like herbs, tuna, etc.

translations.source: ሁሉም ስሞች፣ ለእርስዎ ሳይ ከሚለው ቃል ጎን፣ በአረፍተ ነገር መሃል እንኳን ቢሆን፣ ሁሌም በአበይት ፊደላት ይጀምራሉ።
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All names, regardless of whether they are addressed to you directly or appear within a sentence, always begin with a capital letter.

translations.source: ይህ የተወሰኑ ግሶችን እና ተሳቢ ግሶችን ለመለየት ይህ አስፈላጊ መንገድ ነው።
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: This is a crucial method for distinguishing between certain verb conjugations and their related forms.

translations.source: በአከራካሪ ሁኔታ ንባብንም ቀላል ያደርጋል፣ መጻፍ ግን በአንድ ስምን የሚወክል የቃል ቅርጽ ላይ ግስ ወይም ገላጭ እንደተጠቀንምን ማወቅ ስለሚኖርብን ይወሳሰባል።
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: Reading can be made easier in complex situations, but writing is more challenging because we need to understand whether a word form represents a verb or an adjective, often indicated by a single affix.

translations.source: በጣልያንኛ የቋንቋ አነጋገር ስልታቸው አብዛኛዎቹ ቃላት ልክ እንደሚጻፉት ስለሆነ በአንጻራዊ ሁኔታ ቀላል ነው
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: Italian is relatively easy to learn because its pronunciation is fairly consistent; most words are pronounced as they are written.

translations.source: የቃላቸው አጠራር በሚከተለው አናባቢ መሠረት ሊለያይ ስለሚችል በጥንቃቄ መታየት ያለባቸው ዋናዎቹ ፊደላት c እና g ናቸው።
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The letters "c" and "g" are the most important to pay attention to, as their pronunciation can vary depending on the surrounding vowels.

translations.source: በተጨማሪም፣ አርን እና አርአርን ለያይተው መናገራቸውን ያረጋግጡ፤ ካሮ ማለት ውድ ማለት ሲሆን ካርሮ ማለት ሰረገላ ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, make sure you understand the difference between "arn" and "arrarn"; "karro" means expensive, while "karro" means a crow.

translations.source: ፐርዢያን በንፅፅር ቀላል እና ብዙውን ጊዜ መደበኛ ሰዋስው አለው።
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: Persian generally has a relatively simple and often regular grammatical structure.

translations.source: ስለዚህ፣ ይህንን የሰዋሰው ጀማሪ መማርያ ማንበብ ስለ ፐርዢያ ሰዋሰው በደንብ ለመማር እና ሀረጎችን የበለጠ ለመረዳት ያግዝዎታል።
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, reading this introductory guide to Persian grammar will help you learn Persian grammar thoroughly and understand sentences more effectively.

translations.source: መናገር ባያስፈልግም የሮማንስ ቋንቋን ካወቁ ፖርቹጋልኛ ለመማር ይቀልዎታል።
translations.reference: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.hypothesis: Even if you don't speak, knowing a Romance language can make learning Portuguese easier.

translations.source: ቢሆንም ትንሽ እስጳኛ የሚያውቁ ሰዎች በችኩለት ፖርቹጋልኛ ቅርብ ስለሆነ ለይቶ ማጥናት እንደማያስፈልገው ሊያጠቃልሉ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.hypothesis: However, people with even a little knowledge of Spanish might conclude that Portuguese doesn't require special attention because it is closely related to Spanish.

translations.source: ቅድመ-ዘመናዊ የጠፈር ምርምር ጣቢያዎች በአሁን ጊዜ በብዛት አርጅተዋል፣ እናም እንደ ሙዚየም፣ ወይም የትምህርት ቦታዎች ሆነው ተቀምጠዋል።
translations.reference: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.hypothesis: Pre-space age research facilities are now largely obsolete and have often been repurposed as museums or educational centers.

translations.source: በቀደመው የስልጣኔ ዘመን የብርሃን ብክለት ዛሬ ያለው አይነት ችግር አልነበረም፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ የሚገኙት በአሁኑ ጊዜ ከሚገነቡት ይልቅ ለመድረስ ቀላል በሆኑ ከተሞች ወይም ካምፓሶች ውስጥ ነው።
translations.reference: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.hypothesis: In previous eras, light pollution was not the problem it is today. It was more commonly found in cities or campuses that were easier to access, compared to those built more recently.

translations.source: አብዛኛዎቹ ዘመናዊ የምርምር ቴሌስኮፖች ጥሩ የአየር ንብረት ሁኔታ ባላቸው ሩቅ አካባቢዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ግዙፍ ተቋማት ናቸው፡፡
translations.reference: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Most modern research telescopes are large facilities located in remote areas with favorable weather conditions.

translations.source: ሃናሚ ተብሎ የሚታወቀው፣ የቼሪ አበባ ምልከታ፣ ከ8ኛው ክፍለዘመን ጀምሮ የጃፓናውያን ባህል አካል ነበር።
translations.reference: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.hypothesis: The "Hanami" festival, which involves cherry blossom viewing, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.

translations.source: ጽንሰ-ሃሳቡ የተቀረፀው ፕለም አበባዎች የምርጫ አበባ ከሆኑበት ከቻይና ነው።
translations.reference: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.hypothesis: The concept originated in China, where plum blossoms are considered symbols of resilience and perseverance.

translations.source: በጃፓን የመጀመሪያዎቹ የቼሪ አበባዎች ክብረ በዓሎች ንጉሠ ነገሥቱን ያስተዳድሩ የነበረው በእራሱ እና በሌሎች የኢምፔሪያሊዝም ነገሥቶች ዙሪያ ነው።
translations.reference: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.hypothesis: The early cherry blossom festivals in Japan, which were initially overseen by the Emperor and other figures of imperial power, revolved around them.

translations.source: በተፈጥሮ ውስጥ ሲሆኑ እፅዋት ምርጥ ሆነው ስለሚታዩ አንድ “ናሙና” እንኳን የማስወገድ ሙከራውን ይቃወሙ።"
translations.reference: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.hypothesis: "Plants, when found in their natural environment, are often considered aesthetically pleasing, and therefore, any attempt to remove or alter them is often met with resistance."

translations.source: በሥርዓት የተስተካከለ የአትክልት ቦታ ሲጐበኙ፣ «ናሙናዎች»ን መሰብሰብ ያለ ምንም ንግግር ያስባርሮታል።
translations.reference: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.hypothesis: When visiting a well-organized garden, the urge to collect "samples" can be overwhelming, even without saying a word.

translations.source: ሲንጋፖር በአጠቃላይ ለመኖር እጅግ በጣም ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እና ለማሰስ በጣም ቀላል ቦታ ነው እና ሁሉንም ነገር ከደረሱ በኋላ መግዛት ይችላሉ ማለት ይቻላል።
translations.reference: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore is generally a very safe place to live and a very easy place to navigate, and you can essentially find and purchase everything you need there.

translations.source: ግን ከምድር ወገብ ትንሽ ዲግሪዎች በስተሰሜን “በከፍተኛ ሃሩሮች” ውስጥ ከተመደቡ ሙቀትን (ሁልጊዜ) እና ጠንካራ ፀሃይን (ሰማዩ ሲጠራ በጣም አልፎ አልፎ) ሊቋቋሙ ያስፈልግዎታል።
translations.reference: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.hypothesis: However, in the northern regions, which are slightly higher in elevation and classified as "high altitude," you will need to be prepared for colder temperatures (at all times) and intense sunlight (especially at midday).

translations.source: በተጨማሪም ወደ ሰሜን ወደ ኬብሮን የሚሄዱ ጥቂት አውቶቡሶች አሉ፣ ባህላዊ የቀብር ስፍራው የመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ አባቶች አብርሃምን፣ ይስሐቅ፣ ያዕቆብንና ሚስቶቻቸውን።
translations.reference: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, there are a few buses that travel north to Hebron, a historically significant burial site where the biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, along with their wives, are said to be buried.

translations.source: ሊጠቀሙት ያሰቡት አውቶቡስ ሄብሮን መሄዱንና በአቅራቢያው ወዳለው ኪርያት አርባ የአይሁዶች መስፈሪያ ብቻ አለመሆኑን ያረጋግጡ።
translations.reference: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: Please ensure that the bus you intend to use actually goes to Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: የውሃ የውስጥ መንገዶች በዓሉን መሠረት ለማድረግ ጥሩ ገጽታ ይሆናሉ።
translations.reference: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.hypothesis: Water features can be a great way to enhance the ambiance of a celebration.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ በሎኢር ሸለቆ፣ በርሂን ሸለቆ የሚገኙ ቤተ መንግሥቶችን መጎብኘት ወይም ወደ በዳንዑብ የሚገኙ የሚማርኩ ከተሞች የጀልባ ጉዞ ማካሄድ ወይም በኤሪ ቦይ በኩል በጀልባ መሄድ።
translations.reference: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: For example, you could visit the castles in the Loire Valley or the Rhine Valley, take a boat trip to the charming towns of Beaune, or travel by boat through the canals of Eri.

translations.source: እንዲሁም ለታዋቂ የእግር ጉዞ እና ለብስክሌት ጎዳናዎች መንገዶችን ከፍተዋል።
translations.reference: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, they have improved access to popular hiking and cycling trails.

translations.source: የገና በዓል በጣም ጠቃሚ ከሆኑት የክርስትና በዓላት አንዱ ሲሆን የኢየሱስ ልደት ተብሎ ይከበራል።
translations.reference: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.hypothesis: Christmas is one of the most important Christian holidays, and it is celebrated as the birth of Jesus Christ.

translations.source: በዓላትን የሚከቡ ብዙዎቹ ባህሎች ከክርስቲያን አማኝ ካልሆኑ አገራት እና ከዓለም ላይ ካሉ በክርስትና ከማያምኑ ሰዎች የተወረሱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the traditions associated with holidays are inherited from countries that are not predominantly Christian and from people around the world who do not adhere to Christianity.

translations.source: የፋሲካ ምሽትን ፀሃይ ስትወጣ ለማየት በሆነ በተጋለጠ ቦታ ነቅቶ የማሳለፍ ባህል አለ።
translations.reference: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.hypothesis: There is a tradition of waking up early on Easter morning to find a place with a clear view where you can watch the sunrise.

translations.source: በእርግጥ ለዚህ ባህል የክርስቲያን ኃይማኖታዊ መግለጫዎች አሉ፣ ነገር ግን የቅደመ-ክርስትና ፀደይ እና የውልደት የአምልኮ ስርዓትም ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.hypothesis: Certainly, there are Christian religious interpretations of this tradition, but it could also be a pre-Christian harvest and winter solstice celebration.

translations.source: ብዙ ባህላዊ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ብዙውን ጊዜ ቅዳሜ ምሽት በቅዳሜ ምሽት ፋሲን ያከብራሉ፣ ጉባኤው እኩለ ለሊት ላይ የክርስቶስን ትንሳኤ ወደ ማክበር ውስጥ ይገባል።
translations.reference: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.hypothesis: Many traditional churches often hold a vigil service on Saturday evenings, with the congregation gathering late at night to commemorate the resurrection of Christ.

translations.source: ወደ ደሴቶቹ ቀድመው የደረሱት እንሳቶች ሁሉ እዚህ የመጡት በመዋኘት፣ በመብረር ወይም በመንሳፈፍ ነው።
translations.reference: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.hypothesis: All the animals that arrived at the islands first came either by swimming, flying, or floating.

translations.source: ከአህጉሩ ባለው ረጅም ርቀት ምክንያት አጥቢዎች ጉዞውን ማድረግ ስላልቻሉ ግዙፉ ኤሊ የጋላፓጎስ ዋነኛ ሳር የሚግጥ እንሰሳ ሆኗል።
translations.reference: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the vast distance from the mainland, the giant tortoise was unable to migrate, and thus became the dominant herbivore on the Galapagos Islands.

translations.source: ሰው ጋላፓጎስ ከደረሰ ወዲህ ፍየሎችን፣ ፈረሶችን፣ ላሞችን፣ አይጦችን፣ ድመቶችን፣ እና ውሻዎችን ጨምሮ ብዙ አጥቢዎች ተዋውቀዋል።
translations.reference: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.hypothesis: Since humans arrived in the Galapagos Islands, numerous mammal species, including pigs, horses, llamas, donkeys, goats, and dogs, have been introduced.

translations.source: የአርክቲክ ወይም አንታርቲካ አካባቢዎችን በክረምት ከጎበኙ ዋልታዊ ምሽቶችን ያገኛሉ፣ ይህ ፀሃይ ከአድማሱ በላይ አትወጣም ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.hypothesis: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic regions during the winter, you will experience polar nights, which means the sun does not rise above the horizon.

translations.source: ሰዓት ሲሄድ ሰማዩ አነሰም በዛ ጨለማ ስለሚሆን አውሮራ ቦሪአሊስ፣ ለማየት ይህ ጥሩ አጋጣሚ ይሰጣል።
translations.reference: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.hypothesis: As the night progresses and the sky darkens, it becomes an ideal time to observe the Aurora Borealis.

translations.source: አከባቢዎቹ ጥቂት የሰፈሩ ሰዎች ስላሉበት፣ እና የብርሃን ብክለት ብዙውን ጊዜ ችግር ስለማይሆን፣ በከዋክብትም መደሰት ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.hypothesis: Because the areas have a sparse population and light pollution is often not a major issue, it's possible to enjoy the stars there.

translations.source: የጃፓን የሥራ ባህል ምዕራባውያን ከለመዱት ሁኔታ በተለየ መልኩ የበለጠ ተዋረድ ያለው እና ደንቡን የጠበቀ ነው።
translations.reference: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.hypothesis: Japanese work culture is more nuanced and structured than what many Westerners are accustomed to.

translations.source: ሱፍ መደበኛ የስራ ልብስ ነው እና ባልደረባዎች እርስ በርስ የሚጠራሩት በቤተሰብ ስሞቻቸው ወይም በስራ መደባቸው ነው።
translations.reference: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.hypothesis: The standard work attire is casual, and colleagues often address each other by their first names or job titles.

translations.source: የስራ ቦታ ስምምነት የግል ስኬቶችን ከማድነቅ ይልቅ የቡድን ጥረት ላይ ትኩረት በማድረግ አስፈላጊ ነው።
translations.reference: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.hypothesis: A workplace agreement should prioritize teamwork and collaboration over individual achievements.

translations.source: ሰራተኞች ለሚሰጡት ውሳኔዎች በሙሉ የበላዮቻቸውን በአብዝኛው ተቀባይነት ሊያገኙ ይገባል፣ እና የበላዮቻቸውን መመሪያዎች ያለ ጥያቄ ሊቀበሉ ይጠበቅባቸዋል።
translations.reference: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.hypothesis: Employees should generally accept the decisions made by their superiors, and they are expected to follow their superiors' instructions without question.
